abstract: The multi-objective reconfiguration model, considering the losses, the compositive voltage deviation and the system reliability, is developed in this paper. The NSGA-II method is applied to solve the model. In the decoding process, the random spanning tree strategy is adopted to avert the emergency of unfeasible solution; in the selection process, any two individuals are compared based on their rank values and crowding distances. In addition, the elitism strategy is also used to make sure that the good individuals in father population can be remained in the evolution process. The results demonstrate the validity and efficiency of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Power Flow calculation based on the improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm (AFSA), a new multi-objective Optimal Power Flow (OPF) calculation method was proposed. To accelerate the algorithm convergence speed and satisfy the requirement of accuracy, Chaos with good ergodicity and stochasticity was employed to initialize the fish school. After improvement the step in the behaviour of AF_prey can be adjusted dynamically, which can speed up the convergence. The behaviour of AF_swarm was also modified to improve the searching accuracy. The improved AFSA was employed to the optimal power flow calculation, which has capability of dynamic optimization and is suitable to deal with the multidimensional and nonlinear issues. The objective function and constraint conditions were treated separately, which turned the optimization issue with constraint conditions to non-constraint optimization issue. IEEE standard model was employed to the OPF calculation with Microsoft Visual C. The simulation results proved the good performance in the algorithm convergence speed and calculation accuracy of optimal power flow calculation with the improved AFSP. And The simulation results verified the feasibility and validity of multi-objective OPF calculation based on improved AFSA.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of power quality unified information platform based on SaaS model
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The existing power quality information systems have the problems of overlapping development, supporting only a single type of users and the information could not be shared and the function could not interact between each other. According to these problems, a power quality unified information platform based on cloud computing SaaS service model is proposed. The platform adopts the six-layers architecture based on SOA; the existing system resources and the newly developed module are packaged as components to constitute services of basic functions; the services are orchestrated or choreographed to complete power quality information management business. The Sichuan power quality unified information platform based on this solution fully integrates the available resources and promote information sharing; supports for both power provider and consumers and friendly interaction between each other.

articleTitle: Calculation of harmonic suppression and reactive power compensation device's capacity configuration in electric vehicle charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The high-power rectifiers in electric vehicle (EV) charging stations may bring serious harmonic pollution to power grid. For different types of EV charging stations, one of the issues concerned in the engineering is that how much capacity of the active power filter (APF) and reactive power compensator should be configured. Previous research has given preliminary configuration principle and calculation formula of the APF's capacity. On this basis, based on the configuration parameters of typical EV chargers and charging stations, firstly, this paper gets the maximum harmonic current and power factor values in the output voltage range of the different EV chargers by doing lots of simulations. Secondly, the capacity of APF and reactive power compensator needed for single EV charger is calculated. Thirdly, the mathematical formula of APF's configuration capacity for the whole EV charging station is presented. Finally, the configuration capacity's calculation results of APF and reactive power compensator for different EV charging stations are given.

articleTitle: Study on the faults of nuclear power plant and effects on transient stability of power system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper the software PCTRAN simulate the new generation of nuclear power plant for the Westinghouse AP1000 accident. Such as the nuclear power plants breaks down, the normal full power operation of the coolant pump rotor for death, loss of feed water, turbine trip and break loss of coolant (LOCA). When a serious nuclear power plant failure occurs, it will result in load rejection of nuclear power. With the electric power system integrated simulation software (PSASP) analyses the nuclear power plant will impact load rejection of the power grid transient stability and suggest measures to improve the power grid frequency and voltage.

Author Keywords: Pressurized water reactor nuclear power plan

articleTitle: The research of power flow tracing analytical algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Based on the principle of proportion sharing and Kirchhoff's theorem, this paper proposed a efficient power flow tracking analytical algorithm. According to the calculation results, this method can generate the down-flow and counter-flow matrix, and obtain single source or single flow coefficient through the Gaussian elimination method. The proposed method can avoid the inverse matrix in the past analytical algorithm, greatly reduce calculation burden, and provide the power flow tracing parallel algorithm, which provide a basis for the application of power flow tracing in large scale power grid. This paper test the correctness of the proposed method in 2 machine 4 node test system, and prove the efficiency in several real power grids.

articleTitle: The research on the affection of the Qinghai-Tibet HVDC transmission system upon operating characteristic of the line protection in Qing-Hai AC electrical power system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Based on ±400 kV Qinghai-Tibet HVDC transmission system, the paper build a closed loop simulation system used HyperSim system and HVDC control protection device. Used this system, the paper researched the impedance characteristics and harmonic constitute of Qinghai A.C. electrical power system in different faults, analyzed the proportion of harmonic component in voltage and electric while various faults at different point, and studied the impaction of directional protection, differential protection and distance protection for the AC transmission line according to the characteristics of protection operation.

articleTitle: Integrated application of several automated monitoring systems for distribution network in dispatching
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: During the recent years, several new automated monitoring systems for distribution network such as D-SCADA, Load-monitoring System and Intelligent Fault Indication system have been put into use in shanghai distribution network. These systems can measure and send the operating data of the distribution transformers and lines to the dispatchers in real-time. After intergraded analyzing the data supplied by such systems, the dispatchers are able to study the operating state of the grid in real-time, then they can determine the faults with more real-time information, as a result the time cost for fault searching have been shorted effectively.

articleTitle: Peak-shift method for reducing facility cost of distribution system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Because of the low cost of electricity, when the concentration of electric vehicle charging and the running of the home appliances during certain hours of the day, the peak load of a distribution substation feeder or pole transformer increases. In general, when the peak load increases, electric power companies change the connection of electrical distribution lines or replace equipment such as distribution substation feeder or low-voltage transformer to high-capacity one. However, electric companies face higher costs when they do this. We developed a new peak shift, `combined method', that can be used to reduce the load peak both of the distribution substation feeder and low-voltage transformers. This method can reduce the need to replace equipment in distribution systems and also reduce the cost of electric power companies.

articleTitle: Research on the problem of rural distribution grid reconstruction to meet the demand of intelligent power distribution
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: According to demand of the intelligent power distribution, the paper focus on the problem of rural power grid planning methods, intelligent power supply mode, etc. This paper propose the new rural power supply mode which is mixed single phase with three phases according to the regional characteristics and load characteristics. And the paper describes technical scheme of medium and low voltage power fiber to the home(PFTTH)based on Optical Phase Conductor(OPPC) and Optical Fiber Composite Low-Voltage Cable(OPLC), describes the distribution automation system and the power using information collection system based on the integration of a variety of communication mode. In addition, the paper introduces technical scheme of two-way interaction between the important power consumers and the power grid based on the internet of things, and introduces the scheme supported to new energy distribution accessing. At last, the paper describes the development prospects of active distribution network in rural power grid.

articleTitle: Power quality improvement with SVC in power supply system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: PCS9580 static reactive power compensation system presents an independent development of fast open-loop control algorithm and closed-loop stable control strategies to provide effective voltage support and reactive power compensation for the power network and load. It can effectively suppress voltage fluctuations, with voltage flicker improvement rate more than 50%. And filters parameters are optimized with good harmonic suppression function, in order to effectively improve the quality of power supply. A complete secondary control and protection strategies is presented here and network configuration solution can effectively achieve the dynamic damping of the power network, transient voltage regulation, and instantaneous strong compensation function.

articleTitle: The verification based on RTDS of fault line selection method for distribute power system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: According to the shortage of systemic experimental environment for fault line selection method, it puts forward a test and research method based on RTDS. A systemic experimental environment consists of simulation models and automatic equipment, and the simulation models are built on RTDS, which can simulate kinds of typical fault and can output the analog signals. Through many types of tests, the test methods are proved feasible, and the algorithm of fault line selection are also proved exact and practical.

articleTitle: The design of analog acquisition system in distribution automation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the concept of the Smart Grid, The implementation of Distribution Automation is more and more important. From the departure of Distribution Automation, The principle of the thesis is the design of hardware of the system based on dual-CPU and analog to digital converter AD7606 with high-precision, and the main workflow of its software design is also introduced. The system can apply in a variety of equipments with its good performance and expansibility.

articleTitle: Failure analysis of relay protection in digital substation based on fault tree
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Fault tree is modeled for relay protection in digital substation in this paper, fault tree analysis is focused on the description of a variety of possible causes and combinations of system failure, which limits to dynamic description and analysis of fault propagation, at the same time, coloring fuzzy Petri nets is introduced to dynamically describe and analyze the system's structural characteristics and behavior, to classify, simplify the system fault tree model, thereby reducing the size of the fault tree, making the factors spread relationship clearer. FCPN model inference algorithm technology is also used for digital substation protection system failure analysis, confidence value of the component factors is obtained to help determine the main factors.

articleTitle: New features for detection of nontechnical losses considering PV installed at customer side
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Nowadays, nontechnical loss (NTL) has been an influential factor on the benefits of electric power utilities. At the same time, with distribute generation extensively installed, the consumption patterns having many similarities between dishonest users and normal customers with photovoltaic (PV) installed. Improving the reliability of NTL detection algorithm becomes particularly important. In this paper, consider the PV installed at customer side, the sunlight intensity and time characteristic related features have been employed to upgrade the performance of electricity theft detection algorithm. Compared with traditional feature combination, this new method gets higher accuracy and robustness to misclassified training data.

articleTitle: A rule-based exception reason diagnosis system for electric power data
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In the power user electric energy data acquire system, due to the fault of electric energy metering device, the exception in grid system, the system file data errors, etc, it produces a variety of abnormal data. Analyzing the abnormal data rapidly, diagnosing the reason that leads to the generation of the abnormal data, will improve the application effect of the acquire system. In this paper, we present an exception reason diagnosis system for electric power data. Based on the expert experience, we abstract an abnormal data characteristic set and an exception reason set, set up a knowledge base of association rules to describe the relationship between them. Each rule contains a number of abnormal data characteristics as the antecedents and an exception reason R as the consequent. The support and confidence of the rule have been defined in the paper. On the basis of the knowledge base, we construct an exception reason diagnosis system for electric power data, using an association rule based classification algorithm to diagnose the exception reason for the abnormal data. The system contains the function to learn the real world experience to correct the knowledge base. At present, the exception reason diagnosis system is playing a role as a supplement for the power user electric energy data acquire system in Fujian province, and is online monitoring the abnormal data and automatic analyzing the reasons for the exceptions.

articleTitle: Study on low voltage ride through test methods for PV inverter
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) inverter is the basic unit for low voltage ride through (LVRT) technology in photovoltaic power plant. Generally,there are two LVRT test methods for PV inverter, one is using reactors to simulate grid short-circuit fault, the other is power electronics simulating of power grid. Base on the study of test methods' principle and modelling simulation by PSCAD/EMTDC, it was analyzed and proved that feasibility and effectiveness of LVRT test methods which provided theoretical support for PV inverter LVRT test platform in this thesis.

articleTitle: Study on the selection method of economical capacity for MV transformers
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: An improved TOC method is proposed in this paper, in which the ratio of cost and revenue is set for the TOC value, the affection of the transformers' economic benefit in return to economic capacity is considered in this way. Moreover, the improved method takes MV/LV distribution network under consideration as a whole, rather than calculates every transformer's TOC separately, which can also be used as a reference for transformers' economic capacity choosing. The distribution network of a typical district in Shanghai is analyzed as an example, in which the improved TOC method is used for choosing MV distribution transformers' economic capacity for the WX and P style substation.

articleTitle: A decomposition and coordination algorithm for reactive power optimization based on block coordinate descent
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Aiming at the inseparable augmented Lagrangian function of the decomposition-coordination reactive power optimization model, the parallel decomposition and coordination algorithm based on block coordinate descent is proposed. The algorithm can be used to distributed parallel reactive power optimization of the whole grid, which only needs to exchange the power and voltage information of boundary nodes between adjacent sub-areas to coordinate, so it can solve the problems of slow computing speed and transmission bottleneck in reactive power optimization of large-scale grid. Besides, the algorithm allows every control center to choose optimization algorithm independently. It realizes the combination of autonomous decentralized and coordinated control. The simulation shows the algorithm can significantly reduce the computing time of reactive power optimization of the whole grid, and compared with the decomposition and coordination algorithm based on auxiliary problem principle, its convergence rate is faster and its computational efficiency is higher.

articleTitle: Research on environmental factors of positive DC corona inception voltage of overhead transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The corona discharge effect is one of important problems in the design and operation of transmission lines. The transmission lines pass by the high altitude region with low air pressure, which brings many special problems to the design and operation of the transmission lines. Temperature and humidity also have obvious effect on the corona characteristics of the transmission lines. Consequently, it is significant to study the impact of air pressure, temperature and humidity on the corona characteristics and discharge mechanism of transmission lines. A computation model is adopted for evaluating the corona inception voltage on conductors, which is established according to the gas discharge theory. The charge simulation method is introduced to the computation model to calculate the electric field intensity. Then the criterion of corona inception voltage which considers whether the number of positive ions in the secondary avalanches is greater or equal to that in the primary avalanche is used to calculate the corona inception voltage of conductors. The influence of air pressure, humidity and temperature on the corona inception voltage of conductors is analysed systematically. Corona inception voltage decreases as air pressure is lowered or temperature is raised. It is mainly due to the enlargement of ionization zone as a result of the increase of effective ionization coefficient. Simultaneity, corona inception voltage decreases with humidity increasing for strengthening of collisional ionization intensity.

articleTitle: Distribution network structure planning based on QAFSA
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper puts forward a new Quantum Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm (QAFSA) which can achieve random and fuzzy dual uncertainty model planning. In regard of the insufficiency of traditional intelligent algorithm in distribution network optimization planning applications, the author adopts an updated strategy of quantum rotation gate and quantum artificial fish rear-end to achieve optimization by combining quantum computing with artificial fish swarm algorithm. The new algorithm can find the optimal solution with smaller fish scale in a short time with the advantages of fast convergence and global optimization ability. The results of the example show that this method is well-adapted to the uncertainty of the grid cost, and has greater robustness and flexibility.

articleTitle: Research on electricity value-added services and development strategy for smart grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Power consumption is an important link of smart grid. Research on electricity value-added services (EVAS) could lead the development of smart power consumption. This paper firstly summarized the development of EVAS all around the world and value-added services in other industry. Then a detailed description of EVAS is given, including information services, network trade services, electricity management services and equipment management services. According to the above contents, the development strategy has been made clear for EVAS in China.

articleTitle: Proposal of environmental adaptation for the next-generation distribution SCADA system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: We address the issue of design of a power distribution SCADA (Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition) system. Our work is motivated by the anticipation that large quantities of PV (photovoltaic) power generation will be connected to power grids in near future. To maintain proper voltage in the presence of large-scale connection of PV to the grid, new-generation distribution SCADA systems need to better observe and control power supply than do the existing SCADA systems. In this work we first clarify the communication speed required by the field network of a new-generation SCADA system. The results of our estimation show that the new field network requires much faster speed than the existing network. This suggests that it is likely that a new fast network will be installed in near future; however, the installation of a fast network will not happen instantly and thus we have to manage a network consisting of slow subnetworks and fast ones. To cope with this situation by adapting the gradual changes of the network environment, we propose the use of middleware as a building block of a SCADA system.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of municipal distribution network structure
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The structure of medium-voltage distribution network is the key factor affecting the reliability of power supply of distribution network, and it is also the critical base for distribution automation and smart distribution grid. Through the research and improvement of common distribution network structure and analysis of common connection patterns of overhead line and cable line, the paper presented multi-segment and multi-contact line, double-ring connection, and n-supply-and-one-backup connection, which are suitable for not only overhead line, but also cable line. The way to solve the increasingly prominent issue of power supply in high-density load area in city is that the double loop of different power supplies must cover each main road of the city. In future, the municipal distribution network structure will be dominated by double multi-segment and multi-contact connection, with the coexistence n-supply-and-one-backup connection and double-ring connections. The planning of distribution network should utilize the contact function of ring main unit and the segmentation function of cable dividing box with double switches to achieve the multi-segment and multi-contact line.

Author Keywords: cable dividing box with double switches

articleTitle: Demand response model and impact studies based on bidirectional interactive of information and electrical energy
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: At present, extensive researches have been conducted on implementation of demand response programs, aimed to electricity price reduction, transmission lines congestion resolving, security enhancement, improvement of market liquidity, manage peak demand by applying price signals and automated load shedding technologies, etc. Firstly this paper presents a summary of Demand Response (DR) in deregulated electricity markets. The definition and the classification of DR as well as potential benefits and associated cost components are presented. In addition, by using the concept of price elasticity matrices of demand and customer benefit function, reduce price volatility during peak demand hours, economic model of demand response programs is developed. Analysis results with the actual case indicate that proposed model helps the independent system operator to identify and employ relevant DR program which both improves the characteristics of the load curve and also be well-come by customers. Most important is to achieve the purpose of cutting the peak and filling the valley.

articleTitle: The improvement of the characteristics of integrated DFIG by battery energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With higher penetration of the wind power generation, the influence on power system is significant. Characterized as instable and discontinuous, wind power will produce certain impact when integrated into local power grid, leading to power quality deterioration, frequency and voltage instability. This study investigated the influence of the battery energy storage system (BESS) on the characteristics of Doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG), and has shown promising improvement of DFIG by BESS. The modeling and simulation are based on the PSCAD/EMTDC software.

articleTitle: The effect of load models on electromagnetic transient stability in AC/DC power systems
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Load models have great impacts on power system simulation, operation and stability. In order to analyze the effects of load models on power system stability, this paper establishes the two-area four-machine system, and the tie lines between the two areas is replaced with the HVDC line which is modified based on CIGRE HVDC Benchmark. Then the behaviours of the load models under the transient stability and small signal stability are simulated. The simulation results demonstrate that the load models have great impacts on the AC/DC power system stability. Meanwhile, the lack of reactive power may lead to voltage instability of AC/DC power system, owing to the load characteristics and the recovery features of HVDC system.

articleTitle: GIS intelligent local control panel in compact substations
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to further save the land and improve the substation automation, a DSAS scheme based on intelligent GIS LCP (Local Control Panel) is proposed. A GIS intelligent device is developed, which integrates traditional GIS LCP functions and the bay electrical monitoring and control functions. The GIS intelligent device samples and processes the bay current and voltage signal, and sends them to the station level system via Ethernet. The device achieves inner-bay interlocking, phase discrepancy trip and synchronism checking by software. The device can monitor GIS status including position and SF6 density, and forecast the remaining life of GIS. The GIS intelligent device, together with the bay protection devices are installed on the same panel-GIS intelligent LCP, next to the GIS. The GIS Intelligent LCP connects to GIS via standardized plugs and sockets, and communicates with the station level system in control room via optic-fibre cables. Compared with the traditional scheme, this scheme saves the land, reduces the cables, simplifies the secondary circuits and improves their reliability. It will be widely applied to compact substation in large cities and hydropower plants.

articleTitle: The analysis of short-circuit withstanding ability for a 800KVA/10KV shell-form power transformer with amorphous alloy cores
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The distribution power transformers with amorphous alloy cores are used to employing the core type structure since they were developed, which results in higher noise level and poorer short circuit withstanding ability. To explore the countermeasures for above challenges, the shell type power transformers with amorphous alloy cores are presented. A new type of clamp is designed to withstand the huge force caused by short-circuit troubles. With the help of ANSYS software, the stress and strain of the end covers and the winding clamps are calculated respectively, confirming the feasibility of this new structural method.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization configuration of electric secondary system of power distribution network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: For the purpose of simplification, the secondary system of power distribution network can be classified distribution automation,smart meter, load monitor,power utility information collection and communication system which provides secure, reliable and real-time communication channel for the above application. According to the security protection regulation of secondary system, distribution automation belongs to the area one application of the electric private network, while smart meter, load monitor,power utility information collection belong to the area four application. Combined with the construction of distribution network communication such as PFTTH, According to the character and area division, the configuration of the secondary system application can be optimized. The paper selects a typical residential community, the secondary system of distribution network and communication program have been optimized. It also researches on such problems as the connection between secondary system and distribution network planning , the connection between secondary system and primary grid structure and equipment, it will provide useful reference for the future planning of the distribution network and construction of the secondary system.

articleTitle: Research on integrated benefit evaluation model of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Mathematical model of economic operation in microgrid (MG) is built, in which using fuel costs of micro-resources, maintenance and operation costs, environmental governance costs, and electric charge interactive with main grid as multiple-objective function, comprehensively considering technical performance of the micro-resources, locally available energy resources and load demand. Improved genetic algorithm is used to optimize economic operation of the micro-resources and bi-directional power flow with main grid. In accordance with the result, integrated benefit evaluation is preceded. Integrated benefit evaluation of MG is reflected in the difference between the profit whether MG is used or not. Comprehensive benefit evaluation model is built consisting of user power costs, construction investment of power supply and power grid and environment overhead expenses as evaluation index of user side, power grid, environmentally friendly degree. Through the research of MG system, the simulation outcome shows that the promotion of MG can reduce user power costs, cut down or delay construction investment of power supply and power grid, and improve environmentally friendly degree, in other words, produce favourable combined revenues, which have referential meaning for investment decision of MG.

articleTitle: Intelligent design and application of on load capacity-regulating distribution transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: On load capacity-regulating distribution transformer as an energy-saving distribution transformer, which includes automation control technology, communication and computer. It solves the problem that light-load and over load because of the season load in rural distribution transformer. At the same time, it can monitor the running condition of the transformer, and store automatically acquisition data and event record. From two parts of hardware and software to complete on load capacity-regulating distribution transformer intelligent design scheme, to ensure its safe and economic operation. By calculate analyse the comprehensive benefits, compared with the common transformer, the energy-saving effect is considerable, the economical benefits is obvious, which has engineering application value.

articleTitle: The reliability analysis of distribution system based on Dynamic Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As distribution system reliability analysis methods widely used today can't describe the status of time-related dynamic events, this paper presents a reliability analysis method of distribution system based on Dynamic Bayesian Networks. Dynamic Bayesian network is a time extension of the static Bayesian network, which consists of the initial network and transfer network. Based on Dynamic Bayesian networks, the actual value of the component failure rates and repair rates can be accurately reflected; and failure frequency and duration of distribution system can be calculated. In this paper, firstly, the theoretical basis of the Dynamic Bayesian Network is introduced, then the Dynamic Bayesian Network model which can analyze the reliability of distribution system is established, and finally the validity of the proposed method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Application of GA based fuzzy neural network predictive control in Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In accordance with the technique features of Active Power Filter control in harmonics suppression, e.g., time lag, non-linearity and frequent disturbance in work field, a fuzzy neural network predictive controller based on genetic algorithm is designed. By combining fuzzy control, neural network and predictive control, it can enhance self-studying, tracking and anti-interference capabilities of the algorithm, and the neural network can compensate with the limitation of conventional predictive control that based on linear model. With this algorithm the compensating current is controlled, and the simulation experimental curves show that the proposed method is more effective and feasible than PI control or digit adaptive control.

articleTitle: Research on cost management system of distribution network construction projects based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: It is important to construct reasonable and effective cost management system of distribution projects, which can to ensure the rational use of construction funds and improve the benefit of investments. It is reasonable to apply data mining technology in distribution projects cost management. A system of distribution project cost management are constructed based on data mining, which combines classification model, cost analysis model and cost forecast model with cost evaluation. The new system can achieve comprehensive analysis and realize rapid evaluation. Finally, the system is verified to improve efficiency of distribution project cost management.

articleTitle: Application of rough set-based distribution network fault location approach in Trouble Call Management System
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Trouble Call Management System (TCM) is an application information platform structured by SMEPC to face the unified management of the whole process of fault call and repairing, which integrated functional modules such as fault auxiliary analysis, automatic filtration of work orders, reasonable deploying of fault repairing resources and intelligent auxiliary decision for fault repairing schemes into the Power Production Management System. These functions were based on the accurate location of fault. Studying the distribution network fault location approach based on rough set and applying to Trouble Call Management System can promote the efficiency of the failure reparation, which improves the response ability of power network under emergency condition, and ensures the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Charging power forecasting for electric vehicle based on statistical model
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Considering three aspects of ensuring energy safety, reducing greenhouse gas emission and competing for technical leading edge of new energy vehicles in the world, the large-scale promotion and application of electric vehicles is an irresistible trend in our country. With Beijing as a research object, a statistical method is used for forecasting charging power of regional electric vehicles in the paper. Based on existing traffic statistical data, and fully considering the randomness of electric vehicle's charging in time and space, the random distribution model for initial load state and initial charging time is established, to finally work out the regional daily charging load curves for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on the compensation capacity of the distributed energy storage in substation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Considering energy storage system as a power compensation device in substation, energy storage system capacity is calculated with different compensation depth based on analyzing the substation load characteristics. From the perspective of economic, reasonable compensation depth and capacity of the energy storage system in substation is obtained. Case study shows that the method can get the compensation depth according to specific substation load characteristics. Combined with the construction investment, reasonable compensation depth of substation make the “peak load shifting” in the substation became economic feasibility.

articleTitle: Distribution automation communication technology based on IEC 61850 and Web Services
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to reduce data point table check work between the power distribution remote terminal unit (DRTU) and distribution automation master system, this paper propose the distribution automation communication architecture based on IEC 61850 and Web Services. First, the information model and information exchange model of DRTU is studied. The standard information model of DRTU was established by using the IEC 61850 logical node. The IEC 61850 Web Services mapping is studied and realized the information model and real-time data transmission. Through the prototyping, it is verified that the IEC 61850 Web Services mapping can meet the demand of distribution automation communication.

articleTitle: Research of the influence of initiative anti-islanding protection in high penetration rating of distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The initiative anti-islanding protection is used extensively because of the capacity of decreasing or removing Non-detection zone and no additional cost for MPU in converter interface. But the essence of initiative anti-islanding protection is injecting disturbance into the system. When the distributed generation interconnects to the utility, the initiative anti-islanding protection would affect the power quality and decrease the stability margin. This essay researches the influence of the initiative anti-islanding protection in high penetration rating of distributed generation. By theoretical researching and emulation verifying, the conclusion is obtained that the initiative anti-islanding protection would adversely affect the power system in high penetration rating. It would decrease the stability margin of power system and reduce the power quality.

articleTitle: Preliminary study of the evaporative cooling cast resin transformers
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Evaporative cooling transformer, using inflammable fluorocarbon liquid as insulation medium and coolant, is suitable for some special applications in utilities. However, the fluorocarbon liquid is so expensive that the evaporative cooling transformer must be developed economically with effective method to save the coolant cost. A preliminary study for exploring the configuration of evaporative cooling cast resin transformer is implemented and presented in this paper. The epoxy resin is the solid insulation, while the fluorocarbon liquid is the coolant, which could enhance the cooling effect and reduce the temperature rise of the transformer evidently. After comparing the cooling effect of several cooling methods, the design plan of the evaporative cooling cast resin transformer has been chosen and verified.

articleTitle: Optimal placement and dispatching of distributed generation in regional power grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In traditional study of distributed generation a complete solution for determining DGs' allocation and operation is lacking. For this reason, optimal placement and dispatching is investigated in this paper, which divides the problem into two major parts. An optimal placement model for determining the sizes and sites of DGs is developed, which takes the operation and risk fees as its objective function. Based on the different strategies, two optimal dispatching models are also developed which determine the 24 hours-operation of DGs and energy storage. An example illustrates that the models developed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Effect of substation infrared temperature measurement results of factors and solving methods
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The infrared temperature detecting technology is effective in detecting thermal defects of electrical equipment. During the routine inspection on equipment, operating personnel could adopt infrared thermometer in inspecting equipment temperature for improving equipment health monitor and technique in noticing equipment defects, as well as maintaining a low frequency and duration of outage to ensure equipment safety and effective operation.

articleTitle: Modeling and analyzing on volt-ampere chracteristics of arc fault
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to detect arc fault effectively, providing certain theoretical basis for arc fault detection technology, researching from the basic characteristics of arc, through establishing the static model of arc fault, analyzing the static volt-ampere characteristics of arc fault and the arc stability affected from resistance, the power supply voltage and volt-ampere characteristics; analyzing the dynamic characteristics of arc fault based on power frequency and phase characteristic of arc fault line voltage and current under power frequency half cycle.

articleTitle: Research on enhancing the communication reliability rate of distribution stations in Peri-urban areas
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Currently, communication conditions are not satisfactory in the distribution network of Peri-urban areas, due to that carrier communications are often subject to the impact of various factors. It's still difficult to improve carrier communications fundamentally on the technical means. On the other hand, wireless communication technology is becoming more and more mature with a high success rate of communication. The field tests showed that it meets the distribution network communication needs on effectiveness, economy, feasibility to install wireless communication module on part of distribution stations which are unable to communicate, instead of carrier communication. For communications in those areas of broad terrain, more dispersed distribution, peri-buran areas in the rapid development, it has the advantages of low cost, small amount of engineering and environmental constraints to install wireless communication module to replace the carrier communication, which can improve the reliability rate of distribution station communication fundamentally at a stage that fiber can not be popularized in large areas.

articleTitle: System stability and its influencing factors analysis of the isolated wind-solar-diesel- battery hybrid micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: An isolated micro-grid system of wind-solar-diesel-battery hybrid power generation is suitable for remote areas and islands. Possessing qualities generally attributed to the isolated micro-grid are inadequate anti-disturbance ability and weak stability. Power system stability analysis is needed for providing some suggestions and advices to planning and design. This paper analyses system stability of an island isolated micro-grid at different operation modes. Based on the results, reasonable operation modes and system reserve demand are proposed for long-term, efficient, and stable operation of the isolated micro-grid. Sensitivity analysis has made to find critical factors which mostly affecting system ability, such as transformer selection, low voltage ride-through capability and so on.

articleTitle: The study of combined control strategies for active power filter
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Current tracking control method of active power filter can obviously influence the performance of shunt active power filter. This paper analyzes the operating compensating principles of APF in detail, and introduces fundamental principles of hysteresis control and space vector control strategies. Based on the advantages and disadvantages of each control method, the combined control strategy of hysteresis current control based on space vector is designed. Simulation model with MATLAB is built and simulation results are compared and analyzed in detail, which verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the combined control strategy. The work done in this paper can afford theoretical base for the real project.

articleTitle: Research on design for the grid connection converter of AC PEL
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The AC power source can be tested by the PEL (Power Electronic Load) expediently and economically. The GCC(Grid-Connection Converter) of the PEL should send back the recycling energy to the utility grid with high power factor and low harmonics components. Considering that the single phase PEL can be widely used to test the single phase or three phase power source, the single phase PEL is analyzed in the paper. The paper gives the electrical model and the control scheme based on the GCC's circuits, and analyzes the harmonic components based on the structure and the function of the PEL. The effects of the notch filter, low-pass filter and mean filter are compared, and the mean filter has been chosen to filter the harmonics components mixed with the dc voltage, for its perfect steady-state characteristics. Large inertia links such as DC capacitor with large capacity and means filter deteriorate the dynamic characteristics, a small signal model based on active power balance is constructed, and feedforward control strategy is applied to ensure the whole system with perfect dynamic response when the input voltage, input current and grid voltage flicker fluctuate. The improved repetitive controller is employed to ensure the inner current loop with zero-errors track characters and hold the GCC with near unity power factor. The experimental and simulation results show that the analysis in the paper is right and the new control scheme is effective. The conclusion can be applied in the control strategy of GCCs, which are used in the distributed power supply system such as Photovoltaic power generations.

articleTitle: Calculation and graphical display of surge current due to closing loop based on dispatching and distribution integration loop automatic search and automatic layout drawing
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The close-loop operation is the important method of adjustment operating mode in medium voltage power distribution network. This paper uses the loop automatic search method for fast and accurate identification of close loop path, and provides a simplified model method to calculate the surge current due to closing loop based on the Close-loop transient process theoretical analysis. Then show the graph of Close-loop network by automatic layout mapping technology to provide auxiliary decision of closing loop operation.

articleTitle: Dynamic risk assessment of power system catastrophic event caused by cascading failure
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Considering highly coupled relationship between network topology and electrical operation state in the physical properties of power grid, a new method based on uncertainty risk assessment theory and connection number theory is proposed. The proposed dynamic comprehensive assessment method takes into account of static direct risk and dynamic potential risk to work up the comprehensive risk index. Though compare self-layer comprehensive risk index with next layer comprehensive risk index the failure propagation process is divided into cumulative effects stage and cascade effects stage. Then, ranking the failure events by the comprehensive risk index is to evaluate risk of event. Simulation results from the assessment of an area grid in china shown that the proposed method is practical and it can depict the complete risk of catastrophic events in power system well.

articleTitle: An investigation into the operation life of transformers
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper presents results of a study on solid insulation aging of a number of oil-immersed power transformers, some of them have operated for more than 40 years. The contents of furfurol were measured, in addition to that of dissolved gases in transformer oil, by applying the HPLC method. Based on measured data and the traditional theory of solid insulation aging, it is suggested that the aging of solid insulation in these transformers is not serious even after 50 years' of continued operation, because there has been no local overheating or sustained transformer overload during their operation.

articleTitle: The research into cooperation mode in the establishment of urban power grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the acceleration of China's urbanization, the external environment of power grid construction is becoming increasingly severe, and how to implement coordinated development of city and power grid proves to be a critical issue. The paper systematically sorts out major typical cooperation mode in the establishment of urban power grid, which have been widely used in domestic, discusses the cooperation content between the power grid enterprises and the external actors, including the government, developers and power users, in various ways of financial support, tax policy and transfer of resources. The advantages and problems of the different modes is deeply analysed as well, and recommendation to promote effective cooperation to build and achieve win-win situation is finally put forward.

articleTitle: Distributed systems to optimize power distribution and support microgrids
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper explores the structure, use, and value of Distributed Grid Management as a process and technology to support distributed grid optimization functions and microgrids to better integrate into the electrical grid small quantities of local, distributed power generated from renewable resources. The paper describes the value of distributed distribution management as it applies to Microgrids to support overall value in moving electricity generation toward a more sustainable model. We will discuss operational demonstration projects in San Diego, California, USA, and another planned in Shanghai.

articleTitle: The research and realization of the low-voltage simulation for the resonant grounded system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to study operational features of resonant grounded system deeply, and test all performance indexes of the control device of arc-suppression coil, this paper comes up with the research ideas and implementation of the low-voltage simulation environment, describing its technology parameters and building principles of the major parts in detail. Functional tests on control device of the arcsuppression coil have been down, including capacitive current measurement, automatic resonance, automatic tracking, single-phase grounding and so on, guiding the work on the research and development of the arc-suppression coil.

articleTitle: Studies of components configuration of intelligent transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper classifies components of intelligent transformer and carries out systematic introduction about each classification, making components of intelligent more systematic and convenient for selection and application. According to the relevant standards and definitions, configuration components of intelligent transformer can be divided into 3 parts, namely Traditional component, intelligent electronic device (IED) as well as intelligent components ark. And carries out systematic introduction about said classifications and some notices on their application of intelligent transformer. Through classifying and introducing components of intelligent transformer, we may understand more profoundly the intelligent transformer and select and use components of of intelligent transformer more conveniently. configuration components of intelligent transformer can be divided into 3 parts, namely Traditional component, intelligent electronic device (IED) as well as intelligent components ark.

articleTitle: A novel MOA detection method based on GPS wireless synchronization
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A novel metal oxide arrester (MOA) detection method and its application system, based on GPS technology, have been developed to detect the fundamental harmonic of the MOA resistance leakage current, which uses the GPS time service to realize the high-precision offsite synchronous sampling, and the phase difference algorithm based on Fourier series which can reduce the interference of high-order harmonic and make the detection precision higher. At the same time, it employs the radio frequency communications based on nRF905 to simplify the detection wiring. The method helps to resist power outage and is convenient to operate, which has a positive meaning to the power supply reliability in a power system.

articleTitle: The invention of an insulative rolling
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Traditional live overhead line construction may cause wear and tear to wires and insulated components of operating cars, which not only causes the decline of live working vehicle safety, is but also detrimental to the operational life of the wires. Based on shortcomings in the current construction, a new insulated roll bar is developed to convert sliding friction between the wire and operating car insulation parts into rolling friction, which reduces the wire and insulation wear and tear effectively, thereby increases the operating safety and enhances the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Iut based on power electronics devices
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper proposes a topology of Intelligent Universal Transformer (IUT) with the ideas of three stages and modules series and parallel. Main parameters of IUT are also designed according to the need of smart distribution grid and industrial requirements and a prototype has been carried out. An experiment in dynamic simulation lab in department of electric engineering, Tsinghua University is used to test the prototype and the results have verified the effectiveness and stability of designed IUT.

articleTitle: The online monitoring technology research and pilot application for key distribution equipment based on smart distribution network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Online monitoring technology is the key to online warning and condition maintenance for smart distribution network, this paper put forward cable, power tunnel and Ring Main Unit as the key distribution equipment online monitoring, and the focused issues were analyzed about key distribution equipment online monitoring. With the demand analysis for project, the placement of key distribution equipment online monitoring was chosen, and the technical scheme was proposed.

articleTitle: Clock synchronization scheme based on satellite time transfer in Power User Electric Energy Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In Power User Electric Energy Data Acquisition System, a deadly drift may be generated and accumulated by the differences between devices and environments every day. Therefore an effective external timing system is imperative for clock synchronization. Based on Beidou and GPS satellite, a multimedia timing device and broadcast algorithm are designed. The algorithm mainly including frequently broadcasting Synchronous frame to calibrate clock frequency and relatively infrequently replying response frame to measure the average delay. And experiments show that the synchronization is always better than 1ms with our scheme.

articleTitle: Study on scheduling strategies of hybrid wind/pv/storage power system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Wind energy, solar energy have played increasingly important role in power system. Wind energy, solar energy have nature complementarities with regard to the time and the region with storage batteries, can be achieved to improve the output power curves and reduce adversely affect when renewable energy connect into the power grid. In this paper, three different operation control modes of hybrid wind/pv/storage power system are proposed, and the energy scheduling strategies under different modes are analyzed. Based on these analyses, the scheduling process of hybrid wind/pv/storage power system are also proposed in order to provides reference for further development of hybrid wind/pv/storage power system.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Iut based on three voltage level topology
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper proposes a three voltage level topology and optimal control algorithm of Distribution intelligent Universal Transformer (IUT). Some simulation has been carried out with PSCAD/EMTDC software and the results have verified the effectiveness and stability of the designed IUT. The proposed IUT is simple and practical, and can improve the automation level of distribution networks by increasing the control means of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Research on close-loop simulation for centralized coordination of protection settings
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Distributed energy resources (DERs) pose great technical challenges in control, protection and energy management. To mitigate the effect of DERs and network configuration changes on the sensitivity and selectivity of protection system, a solution for an on-line re-coordination of the protection relays in the active distribution grid based on advanced communication, on-line DER and network connectivity information and results from off-line fault analysis was proposed. A close-loop simulation system is proposed to test the centralized adaptive protection system. Some technical requirements for close-loop simulation are discussed in the paper. With introduction of the testing platform, this paper analyzes the coordination between protection and wind turbine LVRT profile. The testing results show the feasibility and validity of close-loop simulation for adaptive protection for active distribution grid.

articleTitle: Wind turbine outage rate modeling based on operating conditions
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As a green energy, wind is widely used around the world in recent decades. And reliable operation of wind turbines is closely related to the safe operation of power grid. In this paper, factors which cause wind turbine outage are analysed to establish the outage rate model of a wind turbine, from the point of assessing wind turbine operation reliability. First,factors which cause outage of wind turbine components are analysed and classified. After that, the outage rate model of a component is built based on each type of factors classified. This paper divides the wind turbine into two parts,including the generator and the transmission system. The outage rate model of the generator is established based on the voltage and frequency according to the time limit for protection action. And the outage rate model of the transmission system is established based on the failure rate of the transmission system which changes with wind load. Finally,the outage rate of the wind turbine is obtained. An example has been analysed to illustrate the proposed model.

articleTitle: Micro-grid application in the rural areas of West China
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, at first the appearance background electricity grid in the rural areas of west China, and its meaning as well as the concept and structure of micro-grid are resented, and a micro-grid mode of development in the rural areas of west China is given .the development ideas and the future development direction of micro-grid in are compared and summarized. At last, the significance of micro-grid in future development of the rural areas of west China is prospected and some problems to be especially considered in the domestic research on micro-grid are put forward.

articleTitle: Differentiated lighting protection method for 10 kV distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: To improve the ability of 10kV distribution lines for lightning protection and management, it is necessary to remodify ways of lightning protection specifically for the issues of differences in the distribution lines. In this study an integrated solution for lightning protection was investigated, which is adopted the grid statistical method to statistics parameters of lightning and lines. Via calculating the lightning flashover rate with the lines parameters, the lightning protection performance and security level of each tower were evaluated. The reasons why some lines were easy to flashover were also obtained. A technical and economic assessment method was proposed to formulate the optimal lightning protection rebuilding measures in accordance with fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, and the feasibility of this method has been verified.

articleTitle: The current situation and development of Active Power Filter technology
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the wide range of power electronic device applications and the connection of new energy resources to the electricity grid, a lot of harmonic problem will cause the instability of the grid system, the interference and malfunction of the other electric equipment, and affect the safety of the power supply system and equipment operation. This paper mainly discusses the comprehensive research background and development situation of the APF (Active Power Filter) technology, summarize the future development and the market prospect.

articleTitle: Key technologies research on outage plan optimization in distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: There are more and more production tasks with the distribution grid more and more quick growth. However, the traditional outage planning process is very complex and the plan will be adjusted from time to time. It is very difficult to guarantee the outage plan to be scientific and reasonable, which will result in numerous duplicated outage, power sales lost and low work efficiency. To solve the above problems, this paper studied the key technologies for outage plan optimization in distribution grid. First, this paper proposed a three-layer optimization framework, namely department optimization, coordination optimization and global optimization. In the department optimization layer, an expert knowledge based rules reasoning engine is proposed, which efficiently helps the plan-maker to find and correct the mistakes. In the coordination optimization layer, we addressed a mulit-agent coordination optimization algorithm, which helps different departments to collaboratively work together and then reduced the duplicated outage. In the global optimization layer, a mulit-objective complex constraints programming model is built up and the model is solved by CPLEX, which helps the plan management team to handle the overall plans and make a scientific and reasonable plan. The model and algorithms proposed in this paper have been successfully applied in Pinghu Power Supply Company. After two-years' application, the index ASTC-3 (average scheduled interruption times of customer except limited power supply due to generation shortage of system) has been reduced by 40.8% and the index AIHC-S-3 (average interruption hours of customer due to scheduled except limited power supply due to generation shortage of system) has been reduced by 45.2% and the power sales has been increased by 20.5%. The successfully application shows the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithms.

articleTitle: Network-based Dijkstra algorithm for fault location with traveling wave
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to solve the problem caused by any fault in locating equipment, start-up failure and time record error of location failure on the traditional both-terminal traveling waves location on power line fault, the information fusion and Floyd algorithm have been proposed. But these algorithms have some shortages which include long time complexity and need undo network and the weight matrix cannot automatically generate etc. On the basis, this paper proposed a novel algorithm network-based Dijkstra algorithm for fault location with traveling wave. The established PDR matrix can be used as basis of information fusion processing and the different matching combination of the traveling wave positioning device of each observation point, to find out the practical fault point. Simulation results show that the algorithm has a high precision and robustness for locating the power transmission line faults and the location error is less than 100m and has a good fault-tolerance.

articleTitle: Application of the Lightning Location information in the forewarning and control of the power system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Lightning strike is a great threat to the power system operation and security. This paper proposed a method of generating anticipated accidents of power system with the information provided by Lightning Location System (LLS) and the dispatching automation platform D5000. At the same time, this paper also proposed a method of assistant decision making for the dispatchers. Both the methods are applied to a software packagein the dispatching automation system in Sichuan Power Grid. An example of the online application is used to verify the effectiveness of the methods.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization in distribution network considering seasonal load changing
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper presents a reactive power optimization method considering seasonal load changing based on a two-year project. Data of lines, transformers and seasonal load were taken into account to create a simulation model. By taking the moment when the load is maximum in each season, flow of the distribution network was calculated. The calculation results were closer to the actual measurement results. Based on Genetic algorithm, four reactive compensation plan along with seasons were got. The paper got a best project Considerating the line losses, Voltage qualification rate and bus voltage Security. The best reactive power optimization result can significantly reduce the distribution network losses and improve voltage qualification rate.

articleTitle: Researching on the operation pattern of the owner of power construction project department
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This article, in view of disadvantages of the project management of current electric power enterprise, in reference to the relevant literature, investigates the management mode of existing electric power enterprise and then makes analyses and summaries, and puts forward improvement from organization, responsibility, business area and comprehensive evaluation according to the actual situation of the given project department management mode, strengthens the project management level and achieves positive results. The application is proved in practical. Through using the project management mode on the construction of JIADING Power Supply company's HUISHAN 110 kV substation, expounds the important role of the project owner in 110 kV substation construction by researching data, tracking and analyzing.

articleTitle: Studies on the monitoring and control platform of microgrids
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Energy management is one of the key spots in the research of distributed energy system. Based on the idea of centralized hierarchical control,a three layer monitoring architecture is presented. After analysis application functions of layers from monitoring system, A micro-grid integrated monitoring platform based on micro-grid CIM complies with IEC 61 970 is proposed, consisting customer interaction, energy management, system operational control, data model, etc. Finally using x20 series controllers, from B&R, developed in AS 3.08 integrated environment; the micro-grid integrated monitoring platform is built. The successful operation experience in the PV-ESS micro-grid, located in the National Solar experimental verification center, and related testing results verify the correctness of the micro-grid design of integrated monitoring platform developed control software.

articleTitle: Fault location in combined transmission lines using traveling wave for smart recloser control
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A traveling wave fault location method for combined transmission lines based on search algorithm of pre-value look-table is presented. In this method, it tries to practice upon the time difference of fault induced initial traveling wave detected at the two ends of lines and the default time mid-point for the search direction, then the fault section is determined through comparing with the time difference between the arrival time of each overhead line and underground cable connection point. Thus the fault point is calculated by the double ended fault location formula. Based on this, an recloser control scheme is used: recloser signal is locked when cable fault happens, otherwise, be opened. EMTP simulation results show that, this method can determine the accurate fault location, the error is no more than 50m. It is unaffected by transition resistance, fault type and fault location, can precisely realize smart re-closing and be strong practical.

articleTitle: Research of power system fault diagnosis method based on information identification
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The main current research achievements for power system diagnoses are summarized, a fault diagnosis method based on information identification is proposed in this paper. Through the analysis of the power flow difference between normal operation and fault tripping, a fault equipment confirmed algorithm based on abnormal changes in the structure of power grid is developed, the evaluation of the action of the related relay protection and circuit breaker is realized by taking the confirmed fault equipment as the beginning of logic analysis. In order to identify the fault information sent out by SCADA system,accident information,abnormal information and status changing information are used in a identify fault information model. The model analyses these three parts information and identify their validity. The model combining with the fault diagnosis method received good results.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive transient segment of SLG fault location in neutral non-effective earthed system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The duration of single-line-to-ground (SLG) fault transient signal is greatly influenced by the fault resistance in neutral non-effectively earthed power distribution system. This paper presents a method using the effective segment of transient signal identified by the magnitude of transient signal adaptively for SLG fault location. Therefore, available fault location method can adjust the length of the effective transient signal segment based on the fault cases. The advantage of the presented method is that it can make full use of the transient signal and the accuracy and robustness of the result can be enhanced. In this paper, the location principle is deduced and different approaches are introduced to extract the charge signal, including real wavelet transform, complex wavelet transform and S transform. The validity of the algorithm is studied within MATLAB Simpowersystem environment and the results show that S transform has better accuracy for SLG fault location.

articleTitle: Intelligent online monitoring of power capacitor complete equipment in substation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The general structure of capacitor complete equipment inside the substation and internal structure of single capacitor are introduced and analyzed in this paper. Based on this, a mathematical model is established to simulate several possible damages of internal component of single capacitor by using computing software, and then some applicable conclusions are drawn. In accordance with China's overall trend of developing smart grid, a system of intelligent online monitoring applicable to the substation capacitor complete equipment is figured out, and a pre-detection of fault symptom of the power capacitor is able to detected, and the fault could be analyzed and located.

articleTitle: Research of wind power system mathematical model based on a quadrupole six-phase electric excitation synchronous generator
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper deals with the modeling of the semi-direct drive type wind power generator of a wind farm at Chongqing. The mathematic model of the quadrupole six-phase electric excitation synchronous generator in dq0 reference frame is presented, as well as the simplified model of rectifier-inverter. Taking the regional grid into consideration, the dynamic model of the overall wind farm is then obtained. As for control strategies, excitation voltage control is adopted to maintain the DC voltage constant, and the PWM inverter is controlled to realize zero reactive power output and the maximum power point tracking (MPPT). Finally, the simulation model of the wind power system is established based on Matlab. Operation performance at different wind conditions is simulated and analysised. The simulation results verify the validity of the proposed model and employed control strategies.

Author Keywords: quadrupole six-phase electric excitation synchronous generator

articleTitle: Voltage uncertainty evaluation of network with wind power integration
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The random fluctuation of wind power output will cause the voltage fluctuant randomly in the distribution network with wind power integration. However, there is not a perfect evaluation index and method for its comprehensive evaluation at present. In view of this condition, this article focuses on the overall and the partial two aspects of the voltage fluctuation and constructs three voltage uncertainty evaluation indexes including voltage distribution index, skewness index and retention index. These proposed indexes can well reflect the random distribution of the voltage in distribution network with wind power integration.
