Combining the proposed indexes, the evaluation method and process of the voltage uncertainty in the distribution network with wind power integration based on Monte Carlo sampling is researched in this paper. The IEEE 36-bus system is taken as example to verify the effectiveness of these proposed indexes and methods. The proposed indexes in this paper would provide reference for analysis effects on the power grid voltage by wind power.

articleTitle: Typical power supply mode of remote rural areas
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: First, the paper describes the power supply status, characteristics and needs in remote rural areas in china; then raised several technical demand for electricity supply in remote rural areas, including 35/10kV light substation, 35kV light transmission lines, 35/0.4kV distribution transformer, single & three-phase hybrid power supply technology, distributed generation technology, etc. On the basis of the application of these technologies, according to the status of different regions and specific needs, the paper proposes four typical power supply mode for remote rural areas. The application of typical power supply mode will improve the power quality and supply reliability of rural power grids, the development of rural power grid will be more regulated, orderly, safe and economical.

articleTitle: The project of distributed generation connection based on graded-controlling output power of generators
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The paper describes the particularity of the mode of the distributed generation access to the power system but not allowed to transmit power to the system. A project is proposed that monitoring the load on user side in real time, and recording the load's supply and demand, then dividing the generator's power by the ratio of the generator and the user's total load for several degrees. Once the load and generator output reach the critical balance, a part of the generators will be cut according to the degree, which can not only avoid the adverse-power protection acting, but also make a full use of the distributed generation to promote its economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on multiple hierarchical DC micro-grid based on photovoltaic generation systems
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Micro-grid is suitable for popular utilization of distributed renewable energy generations. It can save grid-connected photovoltaic inverter and some rectifiers for DC loads when connecting photovoltaic generation to local loads by DC micro-grid, and the energy use efficiency increases dramatically. This paper proposed a multiple hierarchical DC micro-grid based on photovoltaic generations. The photovoltaic generations dispersed in different building roofs can be mutual backups while contacting them through DC micro-grid, and the energy storage devices have an easy access to connect in different forms, improving the system reliability and reducing the construction cost.

articleTitle: Study on the behaviors of electric power consumers in smart grid environment
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As one of the stirring direction of research and development in power grid, the construction of smart grid is thought to be a revolution of electric power industry. And two-way interactive communication between the grid and power consumers will be an important part of the power consumption business in the future. As we know, different consumption behaviors of power consumers will bring different influences both on the safe operation of power grid and the economic of consumers. In this paper, the behavior characteristics of different power users of smart grid environment is full taking into account, and the types of energy saving, interactive service guiding, and new service requiring classification method is proposed based on the theory of consumer's behavior and customer marketing. Point to different development potentials of power consumers in smart service fields presently, the preferential development of energy-saving services to the industrial users is put forward. Meanwhile, the commercial operation model research on the intelligent power consumption filed should be developed as soon as possible. Finally, an energy serving case proposed in the paper proved the feasibility and correctness of the findings.

articleTitle: A spatial load density forecasting method based on cloud theory and fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Spatial load density forecasting is the basis of distribution network planning. In view of the features of spatial power load density forecasting and the uncertainty of human's judgment, this paper presents a spatial load forecasting method based on cloud theory and fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to improve the forecast inaccuracy. Cloud generators and inference rules were established to quantize the qualitative factors and obtain the objective weights of the influencing factors. Triangular fuzzy number is introduced to the model for indicating the judgments of experts while the AHP is used for dealing with the judgments so as to obtain optimal subjective weights of different factors. The spatial load density was forecasted by using the synthetically weights. An example demonstrates the superiority of the proposed model in spatial load density forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on dispatch scheduling model of micro-grid with distributed energy
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the increase of distributed energy connected into power grid, the traditional power gird is changing from centralized control into interactive power system with two-way flow of information and energy. Both the distributed generation and electricity from power grid can meet the load demand of this micro-grid system. So it is quite different from the traditional dispatch model consisted of power generation, transmission, dispatching and consuming. In order to ensure the safety of power grid and the optimization of micro-gird, it is needed to research a power grid side dispatch scheduling model of the micro-grid. In this work, a micro gird, which can purchase electricity from power grid, is presented. This micro grid also contains other distributed energy including solar photovoltaic arrays, wind turbines, micro turbines, and storage batteries, self-owned power plants. The operation object of the micro-grid is to minimize the total cost which contains the distributed energy generation cost, electricity purchase cost and sewage cost. From the power gird point of view, this micro-grid can be tread as a load. So in the case of minimizing the total cost, the electricity demand of the micro-grid should be studied carefully in order to establish a dispatch scheduling model. In this work, the output power of solar photovoltaic arrays, wind turbines, micro turbines, and storage batteries, self-owned power plants are modeled separately according to their power generation features. Considering the volatility of the wind speed, a rolling real-time forecast is used in wind power model. Also the impact of real-time lighting and the temperature of the panels are considered, when modeling the power output of the photovoltaic array. Furthermore, in the model, safety constrain conditions are added to solar and wind power to limit their impact on the safety of power gird. Then the 24-hour electricity demand of this micro-gird under different electricity price level can be figured out, which is helpful for operators in power grid control center to operate and control of this interaction power grid.

articleTitle: Research on the policy of planned-maintenance period optimizing for distribution equipment based on reliability
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, the degradation characteristic of low-voltage apparatus is analyzed. On the basis of maintenance cost analysis, the age reduction factor is introduced, and then an optimal mathematic model is established by minimizing the maintenance cost rate in the whole life cycle. In addition, taking the threshold of failure rate based on availability necessary in operation into account, the optimizing strategy can be achieved to balance economic costs and reliability relations. Finally, an example for SACE E2 is simulated, and calculating results reveal the proposed strategy's superiority that can provide scientific decision support to the planned-maintenance of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Unascertained rational number method applied to assess voltage sag in distribution system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Aiming at the uncertainty in the process of assessment voltage sag frequency in the distribution network (such as reliability parameters), combined with unascertained mathematics, this paper proposed an unascertained mathematics method to depict the uncertainty of the reliability parameters. Based on the traditional fault location method, a new unascertained mathematics assessment model and an approach were presented to assess the occurrence frequency due to voltage sags. This paper is focus on the uncertainties of the failure rate of system components in the process of assessment voltage sag frequency. The proposed method had been applied to the simple 9-node test system. Compared with the current deterministic and interval number methods, the simulation results have shown that this method is correct and usable, the existing point value evaluation method is a special case of the unascertained number evaluation method, the new methods provide more information.

articleTitle: Protection and tripping strategy for pumped-storage unit startup in back-to-back mode
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Back-to back starting is used as a backup starting system for present static stating systems and is the only pump-starting method available during the static starting system is out of work. Meanwhile, back-to-back starting plays an important role in black start of the grid. In the present paper, the procedure of back-to-back starting of pumped-storage hydraulic generating units is investigated and analyzed. The short circuit fault and loss of rotor field failure is analyzed based on the SIMULINK model. Consequently the paper proposes a protection and tripping strategy.

articleTitle: Study on applications of clock synchronization technology in traveling wave location
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper introduces a clock synchronization technology based on PTP (IEEE 1588) by first elaborating on the IEEE 1588 solutions, then analyzing the deficiencies in the conventional system and traveling wave location base on GPS, and finally proposing an application scheme. the method is benefit for improving the accuracy of traveling wave location system.

articleTitle: Investigation of graphics sharing problems between DAS and GIS
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: When using DAS (Distribution Automation System), operators in distribution network dispatch centers pay a lot of attention to single line diagrams of feeders. In order to reduce repetitive work, the single line diagrams for DAS are usually derived from GIS (Geographic Information System). They are exported from GIS as SVG files and then imported into DAS. It is noticeable that DAS and GIS focus on different details and will make the SVG files from GIS difficult to meet the requirements of the operators effectively. Three common problems of project implementation are figured out in this paper. Detailed analyses of the three problems followed by specific solution methods are given in this paper as well. Graphical integration of DAS and GIS is effectively improved and make it possible to realize maintenance of the single line diagrams in GIS, which is call Source-End-Maintenance.

articleTitle: Coordinated control strategy based on photovoltaic generation integration
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Because of the fluctuation and intermittence of solar light, output generation of photovoltaic power system keeps continuous change. this determines it can not to be used as main source of frequency regulation like traditional thermal and hydro units. the output generation will be fluctuated rapidly in a large scale when sunlight intensity changes quickly. to make photovoltaic generation better utilized, photovoltaic plants always configure certain energy storage equipment. another effective way is to dispatch photovoltaic generation in cooperation with traditional energy of the operation area, which can further weaken the negative effects of photovoltaic generation. based on unit coordination control and flexible target setting, this paper has proposed a new dispatch method of multi-source power supply to meet the requirement when large scale photovoltaic generation connected to power grid.

articleTitle: Knowing status of an earthing switch in MV switchgear, contact visibility or positive mechanical indication?
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Safety of personnel operating or maintaining MV switchgear is crucial. When work needs to be done on an electrical installation, the equipment must be earthed, since earthing is what ensures the equipotentiality of the working area. Knowing the status of the earthing switch is then critical. The paper critically reviews the different ways to get the information on the status, coming to the conclusion that the positive mechanical indication is the most reliable.

articleTitle: Discrimination method of power frequency ferroresonance in GIS
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Ferroresonance over-voltage is one of the most important factors to impact the inner insulation of electrical appliances. The damage to appliance caused by ferroresonance over-voltage accounted for a great majority proportion in power system. A criterion in neutral-ungrounded power system was deducted in detail to estimate whether the ferroresonance will occur in power system from one manner of working transiting to another manner of working. This criterion deducted by means of analytical method expresses the relationship between circuit equivalent resistance and critical resistance, which can be used to decide the zero-sequence resistance value added to the secondary coil of potential transformer to eliminate the ferroresonance over-voltage. The availability of this criterion was verified under two working states via a practical gas insulated substation.

articleTitle: Study on the safety index of distribution system containing distributed generation and example analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, the safety index of distribution system containing distributed generation is discussed,Based on the research of the power distribution system. According to the practical situation, distribution system containing distributed generation such as the wind power generation unit is considered as a random power,and introduced the concept of “Island formation probability”. Research and analysis of the safety evaluation index of the distribution systems containing distributed generation, from the two aspects of system failure probability and failure consequence. And through the actual example verifies that this set of safety evaluation index of practicality. The set of indicators to characterize the security level of grid connected wind power system for different regions of the network or the same area of the different planning schemes, all has important guiding significance.

articleTitle: Research and application of intelligent environmental control system in underground distribution station
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the improvement of urban development on the city environment and conservation of land resources required, a growing number of power distribution stations are built in the ground. The resulting problems are high temperature, humidity, dirt, noise, poor ventilation toxic gas accumulation and other environmental problems in distribution station electrical equipment operating, seriously affecting the safe operation of equipment and supply reliability. In order to effectively address the issue, intelligent environmental control system with “controllable weak air convection cooling technology” as the core is researched and developed to implement comprehensive management of environmental problems in underground distribution station and has been successfully applied to a typical underground distribution station, achieved the expected results.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent monitoring system of air conditioning and ventilation system in distribution station with 10kV power
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: According to the energy-saving need for power distribution station, we design an energy-saving and intelligent control, remote monitoring system. The intelligent system includes central control unit, SF6 gas sensor, temperature/humidity sensor, air conditioning, dedicated exhaust fan, automatic windows, display terminal, etc. Hardware support is mainly based on Advantech's ADAM5510 PLC and uses C programming language to achieve the function. As to the terminal display system, we choose the Kunlun Winton's MCGS TPC7062K touch screen to display data. The intelligent monitoring system designed in this paper is simple, economical, practical and can effectively reduce the energy consumption of air conditioning and ventilation system, and has some practicality and reference value in engineering and industrial control.

articleTitle: Bus integration technology with self-adaptation to different versions of models
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: IEC61970 CIM standard is normally supported by models exchanged among different application systems of electric power enterprises in the process of DAS (Distribution Automation System) set-up. The models of different application systems may use different versions of CIM as they are built up in different periods of time. A mechanism is urgently required to solve the problem caused by different versions of models in different systems. A mechanism of self-adaptation to different versions of models is given in this paper. If new model versions are added to the electric power Enterprise Service Bus(ESB), corresponding principles will be the only thing needs to be added to the Modal service. No modification to the systems where the models are exported or imported is needed. It has been proved by actual applications that the mechanism can meet the requirements of transformation of different model versions.

articleTitle: Design of information interaction interface between electrical home appliances and smart grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper researches and designs an information interaction interface, which exchanges information between electrical home appliances and smart grid, thus accomplishes the function of data acquisition and appliance control. With regard to the designed logical functional structure of external and internal grid information interaction interface, procedure of information interaction, interaction scheme and communication protocol during interaction process is analysed in detail. The procedure of interactional service between electrical home appliances and smart grid is illustrated by describing coordinating operation of grid information interaction interface's functional modules, by which the goal of power demand response, energy management and power load control is achieved finally.

articleTitle: Proposal of an expert PID control strategy for current controllers in parallel active power filters
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, one conventional proportional integral differential (pid) control and one new current control, for parallel active power filters (apf) design, were compared. because of the system stability constrained, the closed loop gain of the pid control is restricted. hence, in order to improve the performance of the apf, a novel expert pid current control strategy for harmonics compensation was proposed. based on the information of the control target and control rules, the current controller is designed intelligently. if the absolute value of the error trended to decrease, the pid current control keeps its maintenance; if not, then the pid current control applies strong functions. under this method, the dynamic error is reduced, and the performance of the current tracking is improved. simulated results prove the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A voltage analysis for distribution system interconnected by renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: An analysis system that is based on the distributed agent architecture is proposed in this paper. The characteristics of this system are: (1) easily analyzing the combination of power system controls with Demand Side Management (DSM), (2) scaling out, and (3) easy to expand functions. The functions that this system has for use in voltage analysis are also introduced. The effectiveness of these functions is verified from simulation results.

articleTitle: Handheld terminals and out-door pole-mounted switchgear control unit integrated application
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to improve out-door pole-mounted switchgear control system efficiency, while ensuring the safety of staff, out-door pole-mounted switchgear control system needs a safe and stable remote control device. Analysis of the out-door pole-mounted switchgear control system technology background and characteristics, is proposed based on short-range wireless technology, handheld non-contact operation, for the intelligent out-door pole-mounted controller parameter setting, on-site maintenance and daily line patrol work.

articleTitle: The thermal field analysis of GIS bus bar and its application in the temperature on-line monitoring
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In light of an 110KV indoor GIS substation of certain power supply company, two kinds of three-dimensional solid model (straight Tube-Shaped and T-Shaped) of the GIS bus-bar cylinder are established. The magnetic field, eddy current field of the established GIS bus-bar model is calculated under different conditions such as symmetry currents, asymmetric currents based on ANSYS/EMAG. By the simulation, we get the magnetic intensity distribution of the GIS bus-bar, the eddy current distribution of the GIS bus tube distribution and the power losses on different situations. According to the calculation result of the power losses, the SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> fluid, temperature field of the GIS bus-bar is analyzed and calculated by the FLUID142 element of ANSYS. In order to verify the accuracy of the calculation results, the simulation of the GIS tube temperature is compared with the actual temperature measured during the GIS operation under different situations according the simulation. The simulation results are proved to have a good agreement with the measured data..

articleTitle: Thee study of 10kv distribution network's hot load transfer based on the mesh equivalence
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the increase of the tie points in the distribution network and the demand for the reliability of power supply, it has been a natural trend to transfer load without black-out by loop closing. The feature of operation by partitions in 220kV network of Shanghai grid makes the loop current varied in direction and amplitude when loop-closing occurs in lower-level distribution network. This paper analyzes the loop closing between feeders of distribution network. The mesh equivalence was applied in the loop-closing calculation of 10kV distribution network, and the complete algorithm is presented. The sample provides important references for dispatchers to arrange the operation mode reasonably and transfer emergency load in accidents.

articleTitle: Analysis on harmonic current of electrified railway traction network based on multi-port reduced-order model
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to analyze the amplification phenomenon of harmonic currents by the traction network in an electric railway, this paper established a simplified model for traction network using T-type distributed model. Further more the conductors of the traction network were represented by a delicate multi-port model which has been reduced in ends. This model is an improvement for analyzing conductor complex compared with two-port network model. The simulation results of the resonance frequency and the amplification of harmonic currents was given by EMTP-ATP, which verified that the proposed model was an accurate and effective way for analyzing the harmonics in traction network.

articleTitle: The typical distribution network real accident exercises system based on Bayesian game theory
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the continuous deepening of the power quality services, we have a deeper level of demand on the grid stability and security. How to make the best instruction and decision-making in the shortest time to troubleshoot and restore the normal operation of the grid when the power grid has an accident, the skill of the dispatchers is a test. A simple analysis of the existing DTS scheduling training system deficiencies, and acting through the real accident of the distribution network of the Bayesian game theory analysis of the system and the use of instance on this system, and it show the superior for the induction of the dispatcher accident optimal treatment decisions; and show the advantages of the new self-training of dispatchers through the combination and contrast with the DTS scheduling training system.

articleTitle: An implementation of bilateral interaction demo platform with analysis of energy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Bilateral interaction is not only an important feature of smart grid, but also an important means to improve customer's satisfaction. And, the bilateral interaction is important way to implement information interaction between grid and consumers. This paper presents a WEB-based interactive platform designed with AMI system, information collection system, electric vehicle charging for electric system, distributed energy system and online payment system as foundation. This platform can provide residents with energy consumption analysis, load management, online purchase, community services and other functions as well as efficiency service for enterprises. A bilateral interaction system demo platform was built to verify the feasibility of the design and simulate the functions designed in the bilateral interaction system.

articleTitle: Next generation SCADA system for distribution network with large amounts of renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Electric power supply qualities such as voltage quality and high efficiency use of equipment are essential in the future distribution network in which large amounts of renewable energy will be installed. To solve the power supply quality problems, we are now considering the development of built-in sensor in line switches, installing Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) solution integrating system with information exchange technology, the development of new control devices and enhancement of functionality in SCADA (Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition) systems. Especially, in distribution network, development of SCADA/DMS (Distribution Management System) system and voltage control unit is important for maintenance of power quality, cost minimization for countermeasures and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission reduction. In this paper, we introduce next generation SCADA/DMS system technologies that help maintain power quality.

articleTitle: Electric power energy efficient management system based on optimization of energy consumption modeling1
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the development of smart grid technology, power energy efficiency evaluation will be driven to become more intelligent and professional. In order to achieve energy conservation and low-carbon economy, energy efficiency technologies need to be improved. The application of energy efficient technologies has to be enhanced from the supply side, power grid side and demand-side in order to raise energy efficiency effects and update energy conservation technologies. The key technologies, system architecture and advanced applications of demand-side power efficiency evaluation and management system were described in detail in this paper. The monitoring model, efficiency analysis, and optimized control of energy efficiency management system were also elaborated with case studies. The impact and prospect of this technology were finally analyzed.

articleTitle: Development and application of the 10KV distribution line charged wrecker
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In accordance with issues on obstacles winding wires and influence of safety operation of 10 kV power lines in Lin He Power Supply Bureau, in spring and autumn, combining with work practice, a new type of live wrecker device is designed and developed. It consists of aluminum alloy serrated blade, two-way insulation pulleys, insulated operating rod and other components, mainly to clean up obstacle hanging on live power line. Through on-site practice, it is proved that live wrecker device is easy to operate and maintain. It improves the wrecker efficiency and ensures safe and reliable operation of 10kV distribution lines, and significant economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an active distribution network simulator for loss minimization considering distributed energy resource integration
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The integration of distributed generations (DGs) has a significant influence on the operation characteristics of distribution system, especially power losses. In this paper, a distribution system simulation framework with DGs integration is proposed, which can achieve the coordination goal between DGs integration and traditional VAR regulation devices, with the goal of minimizing power losses. In the simulation platform, three-phase steady state models of various forms of DGs are studied, such as synchronous generators, asynchronous generators, power electronics interfaces and doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs). Then the three-phase power flow method with DGs integration is developed and VAR optimization method is exploited. The proposed method is applied on a three-feeder test system and the simulation results show that with regulation of DGs, the power losses are reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of ambient temperature variation on thermometers for oil-filled power transformers
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The influencing mechanism of ambient temperature of oil surface thermometer is researched. The method to discern influence degree of ambient temperature of thermometer is presented.

articleTitle: Study on nuclear power plant dynamic response characteristics and impact of power quality problems
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Nuclear power plant (NPP) generally has large capacity, high security requirements, and is sensitive to external disturbances. Integrating NPPs into power system will result in stability problems in all aspects. This paper established the model of pressurized water reactor (PWR) NPP, and then the reactivity disturbance and power regulation characteristic were simulated and analyzed. The dynamic response characteristics of NPP were verified and analyzed. The frequency and voltage disturbances were analyzed, and the control strategies of security and stability were summarized. The analysis results show that, NPP has the characteristics of self-stabilization and self-regulation, and NPP will be affected by power system disturbances. If the disturbances can be cleared quickly, the NPP and power system can remain stable. NPP requires higher operating conditions on power system such as voltage and frequency. The amplitude and rate of NPP power regulation are limited. The grid and NPPS should take effective measures to ensure safe and stable operation.

articleTitle: The design of distributed dual-core city-county Dms/Ems integrated automation system architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The city-county EMS Integrated System and DMS/EMS Integrated System has been successfully developed and applied in some area. But there is still some duplicated work need to be done in both systems, including: 1) Model and diagram maintenance; 2) Data Acquisition for some substation; 3) Basic network analysis applications. In order to resolve those problems, a new distributed dual-core city-county DMS/EMS integrated automation system architecture has been put forward. This architecture maintains the relative independence of city-county EMS subsystem and DMS subsystem, and adopts distributed data acquisition technology to realized unified data acquisition, adopts automatic model merging to realized main station model sharing, and finally realized integrated network analysis, integrated DTS and integrated AVC, etc.

articleTitle: Application study of embedded partial discharge detection technology for switch cubicles
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: By studying the defects of existing detection techniques for partial discharge of switch cubicle, a novel scheme of partial discharge detection for switch cubicle is proposed in this paper. In the proposed design scheme, all components of proposed detection equipment are embedded inside the metal shell of a switch cubicle, which effectively minimizes the environmental noise disturbance on the detection data. This detection equipment can work automatically and continuously without human intervention, and the detection result is visually displayed in numerical form, which makes it faster and more convenient for inspection personnel to detect the partial discharge of a switch cubicle. Through the laboratory's tested and field installation and operation, the result indicates that the proposed detection equipment is easy and effective in operation, and comparing with existing detection equipments, the proposed detection equipment has higher precision in output detection data.

articleTitle: An experience of the converged communication network for the AMR system in China
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Automatic meter reading (AMR) system is the important components of smart grid. State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC) plan to established an AMR which can cover 200 million energy consumer till 2015, this system can help SGCC to realize the target “Full coverage, collection, full-fee control” in its operational region, the reliable communication channel construction is a premise to achieve this goal. Until now, low success ratio influences the Comprehensiveness and completeness of data and hardly supports the implement of real time price. In addition, few of the smart meter can realize both-way communication and there's a long way to the core concept of the AMI system. With the Long-term tracking studies, the communication mode play an key role besides the poor performances of the main station and acquisition equipments. In this paper, we suggested that optical fiber and high-speed wireless 230MHz private network technologies should be given the priorities, GPRS/CDMA public network can be used as the supplementary means to cover the power users of remote region and beyond the coverage domain of private network. In the local channel, the convergence of different schemes is positive to get ride of the influences caused by Random interference of the channel and environmental change.

articleTitle: New corona ultraviolet detection system and fault location method
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Corona discharge often occurs in high voltage equipment and transmission lines with the elevating of the electrical network capacity and voltage level, which can lead to noise, loss of power and interference with TV and radio. Worse, the insulation of power equipment might be badly destroyed. Therefore, corona discharges in power system get more attention. In this paper, a non-line monitoring system of double channel ultraviolet is introduced for detecting the UV spectrum in ultraviolet sun-blind band (240~280 nm) of the corona discharge in the high voltage equipment. And also, the IHS space image fusion algorithm is proposed to locate where corona discharge occurs.

articleTitle: Network topology analysis based optimal measuring device placement
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In view of the current common situations of the domestic grid that the number of harmonic power measuring points is small, the measuring devices are used both for the harmonic voltage and current, and the measuring points are separated, a method is introduced in this paper, which is applied in the analysis of network observability utilizing network topology assisted by suspicious harmonic injection node. This method makes recursive computation of adjacency matrix and the voltage and current measuring vectors by means of Boolean operation, with small computing amount. The method can be used in the analysis and calculation as well as the optimal measuring placement of the harmonic regional observable network, which has no or separated sensors. On the basis of observability analysis, an comprehensive objective function which has relation with load type and voltage grade is proposed to realize optimal placement and importance sort. The practicality and efficiency of this method has been testified by the example of a regional power grid.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of electricity pricing based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Under the Smart Grid framework, a significant amount of attention has been directed toward the demand-side resources. Price, as an effective means of economic regulation, can be adjusted to affect consumers' ways and habits of the use of electricity, thus is improving the distribution of power flow in the time scale and ensuring the security and efficiency of power system. Multi-agent technology provides a good technical support for electricity pricing involving multiple stakeholders through mutual coordination and collaboration between each agent. In this article, we design a Multi-agent simulation system using MAGE platform. The Multi-agent simulation system includes a regional power company agent and several types of consumer agents. Through the power grid and the users' interactive dynamic simulation, the research provides a feasible method for Power Company to make reasonable price policies.

articleTitle: Control method for voltage regulator based on estimated amount of photovoltaic generation power
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, we propose a control method for a voltage regulator to reduce voltage violation of a distribution line under the constraint of the upper limit of tap changes. The proposed method determines the current tap position by considering potential voltage fluctuation caused by changes of the photovoltaic (PV) output power. The estimation value of the current output power of PV is used to forecast voltage changes caused by the maximum change of PV output power. In this paper, we describe an algorithm to control the tap changer of a voltage regulator and present simulation results of applying the method to voltage regulators with a sample distribution network model.

articleTitle: The optimization study of asset retirement and reuse management in electric power enterprises
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Power supply enterprises often face the problem of large backlog of retired assets because of low attention on retired assets reusing. Taking Shanghai Electric Power Company as an example, this study gives some references to electric power enterprises in retired assets management. Starting from the management and reusing of retired assets, the paper mainly discussed its optimization and the corresponding mechanisms including the operating and security mechanism and information system, which could contribute largely to enhancing retired assets management, raising reuse rate and saving project cost.

articleTitle: Research and simulation on minimized common-mode voltage based on SVPWM modulation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The high power domestic and commercial variable-frequency air conditioners powered by three-phase AC power supply have been widely used nowadays. In order to achieve much higher power factor at grid side, voltage source rectifiers (VSR) become popular. However, due to the high output voltage of VSR, the problem of common-mode voltage (CMV) on its DC link caused by traditional SPWM or SVPWM modulation algorithm is too serious to solve. Thus, the existing modulation algorithms of VSR should be modified to settle the problem of CMV. The paper designs a minimized CMV SVPWM modulation algorithm using non-zero vectors to replace the zero vectors, as well as a dead-time arrangement which causes no effect on CMV. Then the above theoretical analysis is verified via simulation by means of MATLAB/SIMULINK. The obtained results show that the minimized CMV SVPWM modulation algorithm can reduce the CMV, bringing about the alleviation of CMV interference.

articleTitle: Development of wireless instrument for phase verification and determination based on labview platform
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Phase sequence and phase checking is the continuous job in the Distribution system. In this paper we discuss the method of design of virtual phase sequence and phase check meter. The Prototype works steadily and dependably.

articleTitle: Low-voltage area prediction model research based on self-organizing competitive neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The distribution network voltage level is directly related to residents' normal use of electricity, in order to correctly predict the low-voltage distribution network voltage quality, to take timely and effective means to prevent low-voltage phenomenon, the article collects nine indicators to reflect the characteristics of low-voltage distribution network voltage quality which are mainline diameter, mainline type, branch line diameter, branch line type, power supply radius, distribution transformer capacity -load ratio, the three-phase load unbalance rate, single-phase-home number, reactive power compensation rate. Then the article establishes a self-organizing competitive neural network model to automatic cluster the samples into three kinds which are normal, existing low voltage risk and existing severe low voltage risk. Using the known practical result to compare with the calculation results will indicate that the network model has high accuracy and feasibility.

articleTitle: Importance evaluation method on the fault modes of power transformer based on trapezoidal fuzzy number
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The fault modes of the components of the power transformer is complex and highly correlated, and the implementation of reliability tests is difficult because of the high value of the equipment, so it is hard to make importance evaluation by using traditional method. Aiming at those problems, a new evaluation method on importance based on trapezoidal fuzzy number is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the evaluation index system of importance is established which using the Delphi method to formulate the score rating criteria and applying the coordination degree to amend the scores. Secondly, the trapezoidal fuzzy numbers is applied to determine the weight indicator. Last, the importance of each failure mode of transformer is determined on the basis of the indicator combining with the weight through the linear weighting method. It is shown by the instance that this method is convenient and effective, which can be used in making the reliability evaluation and maintenance decision of the power transformer.

articleTitle: Impact on 10kV system of inrush current and its preventive measure
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The generation of inrush current in the 10 kV grid system and the size and impact on the system is discussed in this paper, according to the cause of the inrush current, how to prevent the harm from the technology and grid structure is discussed and finally the adverse effects of inrush current on the system is prevented from the root causes, to ensure normal and reliable operation of the 10 kV grid system, to avoid protection malfunction and mistaken judgment of handling, to increase reliability of user power supply and security of grid operation.

articleTitle: Algorithm research and example analysis of mid-short-term load forecast for new electric connecting residential areas based on Demand Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the social and economic development, the real estate industry rapid development, supply supporting projects in residential area is increasing. Residential areas load has large application for connection and installation, but the actual load is of slow growth, lack of effective ways and means, it's inaccurate to forecast short-term load, difficult to balance the improvement of equipment utilization and to meet long-term electricity demand in the distribution network planning and the preparation of regional distribution network planning programs. The electricity load growth in new built residential area with the relatively high occupancy rate over the years is tracking analyzed, load forecasting method of new residential area to apply for electrical connection based on Demand Coefficient is researched and studied with case, which has good effects.

articleTitle: A scheme of distribution terminal unit accessing spdnet
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper describes a method to solve the problem that IP address pool is too small in the SPDnet access layer by introducing “The Private Network” into SPDnet , such as internal server PAT mapping technique. It is the critical practice that distribution local communication network acts as the private network, only IEC 60870-5-104 protocol's service port (2404) are permitted to open, and it is forbidden that Distribution Terminal Unit in the distribution local communication network actively initiates connection to SPDnet. The method can effectively control the business data to access SPDnet from distribution local communication network, and can reliably ensure the security of SPDnet.

articleTitle: Designation and development of hardware platform for intelligent terminal
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: According to the demand of 126kV intelligent switch with intelligent operative box, an intelligent terminal device by using cooperation control of embedded CPU(STM32F103ZET6 ARM) and Field Programmable Gates (Cyclone?EP2C8Q208C8 FPGA), which is up to the IEC61850 standard, is designed in this paper. Research program of the device is discussed. Starting from the modularization structure design, function of each module, circuit design and implementation method were introduced in detail. A hardware platform was established according to the design. Finally, the article confirmed the correctness of the hardware platform primarily through experimental method.

articleTitle: The optimized design of secondary lead with intelligent transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper carries out a system research on the intelligent transformer under the condition of intelligent power grid. Secondary system acts as nervous system to control and monitor the substation. The reasonableness and reliability of secondary circuit and secondary lead directly relate to the safe and reliable operation of the intelligent transformer and intelligent power grid. This paper discusses the standards and specifications of secondary lead with intelligent transformer. The industry standards and specifications of secondary lead with intelligent transformer shall be established because the intelligentized transformer raises higher requirements for the technological innovation of secondary lead and has greater effect on it. Through establishing the technical documents of secondary lead with intelligent transformer, it will provide reference for the technological improvement and standards of secondary lead with transformer products, which is helpful for the industrial production of intelligentized transformer.

articleTitle: Research of self-adjusted scheme for load towards utilization equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Nowadays, the construction of Smart Grid in China is getting into a raging state and a period of swift development. At the same time, the characteristics of the power load are changing greatly. In this paper, the research of self-adjusted scheme for load towards utilization equipment is mainly for home users, in order to adapt to the changes in China's electric power load characteristics. Focus on family lights, a water heater and an air conditioner, and put forward the self-adjusted principles for their loads, propose a corresponding self-adjusted scheme for load. Through the research, a practical scheme for it could be proposed. Based on it, great enhancement could be made on the facets such as energy saving, the increase of the loading rate, the improvement of power usage efficiency and so on.

articleTitle: Distribution reconstruction based on Bender's decomposition including distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Based on the Bender's decomposition with multi DG for distribution system fault network reconfiguration has been studied, by this solution can obtain the best solution of islanding partition of emergency power supply by DG. The split complex reconstruction Reconstruction of sub-problems interrelated main problem of the island divided and the remaining system able to quickly get the reconstruction program. By calculation example analysis, this solution is proved to fully recovery of power supply load in failure condition and decrease network losses.

articleTitle: Impact of high permeability DGs on future power system and their reliability assessment
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the penetration level of distributed generation (DG) continues to increase, it is necessary to known the impact of high permeability DGs on power system and their reliability assessment. This paper given some DGs operating characteristics and models for dynamic stability analysis, and the impact of DGs on a local sub-transmission system or a local distribution system was studied. An energy margin sensitivity approach for simultaneously processing a set of severe stability was given and an optimal penetration of DGs decision method was proposed to maximize the penetration level of DG on the system. A modified IEEE 39-Bus test system with DGs is used to prove the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Implementation and application of an intelligent platform for time-frequency measurement and analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Aiming at the problems that time-frequency equipment of the power system can not be tested comprehensively, effectively and high-precision, and can not comprehensively analysis of tested data, this paper has designed and developed a highly accurate, comprehensive, intelligent time-frequency test platform, it introduces the overall structure, working principle and the functional analysis of the test and analysis platform in detail in this paper. At last time from time synchronization device's testing application, it verifies that the functionality and performance is meeting the designed goals of the platform and meeting the requirements of the power industry standard test at the same time.

articleTitle: AN implement scheme of data grid for integrated information platform in distribution power network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Effective data management of the distribution network becomes important issues faced by the distribution automation with the increase of the power users and the development of distribution network. Data grid allows users to share data resources transparently and provides unified access with data management interface. So it's suitable for the distribution information management. Globus Toolkit package is applied to build the experimental power grid platform and its security mechanism could grant and manage the users' right of distribution information uniformly. OGSA-DAI is used to bind different isolated data source and realize of grid access and data integration when the process of data access is encapsulated into grid service. Experimental platform can be very effective in shielding the lower operation of the database and provides users with a simple data management interface.

articleTitle: A new phasor measurement algorithm for distribution network based on interpolation theory
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Due to the existence of abundant harmonic source and frequency deviation in distribution network, the accurate phasor result can't be obtained by conventional Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) algorithm. In this paper, by using the linear interpolation to modify DFT window length to exactly equal to the fundamental period of signal waveform, the spectrum leakage could be solved. In addition, the duplicated Simpson formula can accomplish Fourier coefficient equivalence for improving precision, so we can get the precise phasor measurement result by comprehensive utilization of above two interpolation in distribution network. The measuring accuracy and noise immunity comparison between the proposed and corrected DFT algorithm is made by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: The design of Zigbee-based transformer insulation on-line monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As one of the important equipment in the power grid, The operation of the power transformers is directly related to the security and stability of the grid. The oil surface temperature and winding temperature of Oil-immersed transformers can response to the operational status of the transformer timely, for which the author developed a Zigbee-based remote online monitoring of transformer technology which monitor the system operating temperature, the system using Zigbee wireless transmission advantage to overcome the wire transfer some of the drawbacks of remote monitoring is proposed in the local server and remote monitoring machine using Ethernet connectivity solutions to the monitoring unit and data acquisition problem of extension of communication distance. This paper describes the overall structure of the system, working principle and software design.

articleTitle: Method and empirical study of distribution network planning consider demand-side resource
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: How to take into account demand side management program in electricity planning in order to achieve minimum cost both economically and socially is one of the most popular topics of energy research around the world. In this study, based on the status of China's electricity industry planning and demand-side management, a method of distribution network planning consider demand-side resource is proposed. We use cost and reliability as two main factors in this method, and analyze the existing and proposed distribution resources as well as demand-side resources in effect, calculates the overall costs and reliability of each distribution network construction program on a yearly basis. The result can be used to choose the optimal program and its time of implementation, and also to compare with the planning program with no consideration of demand-side resources from various aspects such as investment, reliability and emission reduction. We implement this method for a typical distribution network in China's developed area using actual data, results show that as demand-side resource being considered, the overall cost of the planning program in a certain area is reduced apparently, and the reliability level of each year is improved, meanwhile, when to implement (time of distribution resource construction) is an important factor which impacts both overall cost and reliability.

articleTitle: Studies on Technical Standard for demand response
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper introduced the research and practice of power demand response technology at home and abroad. On the basis of combing the DR standards developed by relevant organizations, gaps between existing DR-related standard and expectation are analyzed. As the requirements of DR standard are discussed, main contents of research on DR standards are proposed, finally, the summary is made for significance of development for the DR standards.

articleTitle: Adaptive OFDM mixed-service resource allocation for broadband power line communication
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: To improve data transmission rate and ensure QoS for power-line communication in Power Distribution Network, this paper proposed a mixed-service resources allocation algorithm based on OFDM system. Firstly mathematical model is built for the mixed-service resources allocation, while the concept of VB (Virtual Bit) is introduced and the priority function is defined. Then the algorithm takes advantage of VB and the priority function to coordinate the three targets which are global subcarriers allocation, local power, and bits allocation. Simulation results illustrate that the algorithm may save more resources under the premise of ensuring fairness among users, and significantly increases system capacity.

articleTitle: Optimal planning of distributed generation in urban power system based on load weight distribution
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Taking the huge economical loss on power grid caused by the overwhelming nature disaster into account, a mutil-object model of distributed interconnected-grid generation is established. The model is based on the function of node islanding operation, construction investment and network loss when major accidents occur in electrical power system. Improved Differential Evolution(IDE) algorithm is adopted to resolve the model. This algorithm can enhance the research efficiency and enlarge the research range by means of dynamic characteristics regulation mechanism and chaos researching scheme avoiding the local optimization of basic Differential Evolution. Compared with genetic algorithm and basic differential algorithm, the efficiency and robustness of proposed IDE algorithm is verified through the 33-node distribution system.

articleTitle: Research and improvement of integrated debugging method for intelligent distribution terminal
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This article makes a brief introduction to the role of intelligent distributed distribution terminal equipment (FA) in low-voltage distribution network, the current construction situation of intelligent distribution network, and describes the FA equipment action test method and the means of joint debugging together with communication equipment. In addition, it points out such practical problems as difficult centralized debugging, poor debugging synchronization, difficult communication joint debugging coordination and the necessity of power outage for re-tests in case of changes in the electric system during integrated automation construction of FTTH distribution station for which a huge number of FA devices are used. Oriented toward the above-mentioned problems and based on the practical situation of project acceptance, this article is aimed at working out a test method for convenient field inspection of the overall action logic of FA device to overcome the current difficulties in the debugging of distributed FA with the concept of “distributed devices, centralized debugging”.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of transformer under DC bias based on Jiles-Atherton model
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A Jiles-Atherton model reflected the characteristic of transformer core hysteresis is established in this thesis, in which difficult parameters identification is the drawback of the model. For identification process is very sensitive to initial values, the relationships between parameters in Jiles-Atherton model and the most representative characters of hysteresis loop are summarized firstly. Hence, the reasonable initial values can be gathered more easily. Then, it is proposed that a parameters identification method based on a sequential algorithm, in which each parameter was optimized in sequence. The mean square error (mse) between experimental data and calculated data affects by each parameter, which is optimization objective should minimize. Compared with existing algorithm, this algorithm is simple, practical and accurate. On the basic, the transformer DC bias model based on the Jiles-Atherton theory is established on MATLAB simulation platform. The simulation results of the hysteresis loops and excitation current are found to be in good agreement with the experimental ones, which strongly proves the effectiveness of this procedure.

articleTitle: The research of diagnostic suggestion with electronic voltage transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to solve the problem of electronic voltage transformers' operation and testing in the intelligent substation, this paper presents a diagnostic suggestion with electronic voltage transformer in secondary circuit. This paper propose that monitoring and recording the ERVT secondary circuit with monitor, analyzing the interference sources by synchronize data acquisition analysis method to solve the problem. The diagnostic monitoring system has been tested and having a good result.

articleTitle: Study on the security isolation technology of power soft-switch system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Following the development of switching technology, circuit-switch based voice communication system used for power dispatching communication shall evolve towards soft-switch system, the security issues of which must be resolved firstly. On the base of P2DRR model, the power system brought forward the security scheme of the secondary system. It gives out four measures to ensure the security of the soft-switch network after analyzing the defects and faults in constructing power soft-switch system using MPLS VPN technology. According to different isolation requirements between soft-switch network and other power operation systems, it gives a isolation project by using security isolation device, Session Border Control, edge communications agent.

articleTitle: Analysis about the parameters calculation of characteristic interharmonic in the voltage source type AC/DC/AC frequency converter
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The three-phase frequency conversion device has been widely used in the high voltage direct current system, AC transmissions, the distributed power generation access system and various power sources. It has been the main harmonic and interharmonic source. Taking the voltage source type AC/DC/AC frequency converter as the research object, a new approach for modeling AC/DC/AC power conversion systems is presented and discussed. The proposed method is based on the modulation theory and the switching functions. Present modulation theory only provides limited equations and it is lack of flexibility for inverters under different control modes. Thus an extended modulation theory is proposed in this paper. Considering the commutation overlap angle, the paper discussed all the states of inverters under phase control and pulse width modulation(PWM) control modes in detail. The accuracy of the results obtaing from the proposed model is demonstrated by comparing with those obtaing from using the time-domain simulation tool.

articleTitle: Energy research of grid scheduling saving electric power
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The power system network loss control problem is not only within the region of optimal control problem, but also the area, upper and lower control coordination and cooperation between regional problem. Various network loss how to control and reduce should become great importance problem to current power grid operation department. This paper study of domestic network loss control domain research, summarizes network loss control classification method based on high voltage power system, put forward power loss control methods, to explore in-depth research network loss control method. Analysis and comparison, and verified by calculation example, in order to realize the grid loss control and put forward some measures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Piecewise price mechanism to induce demand response in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: An effective price mechanism is needed in the Smart Grid to induce demand response. This paper analyses the deficiencies of the traditional price-based demand response mechanism in terms of 1) the information elements in which price is bound with time, and 2) the risk-sharing structure in which consumers bear little price risks. A Piecewise Price based on Equivalent Load (PPEL) mechanism is proposed, in which the fluctuation of wind power is converted to equivalent load, and the electricity pricing is based on tracing the equivalent load. The PPEL is not only reasonable in risk-sharing and risk-controlling, but also effective in reflecting the supply-demand relation and the true value of electricity. This provides strong incentive for wind power integration. The case study based on the 24-hour load profile of a typical summer-day from one province of China and wind power output data from NREL of the U.S. demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed mechanism.

articleTitle: Design and application of overhead line intelligent management scheme for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: 10kV overhead lines of suburb network are difficult to be managed for a long time, a new fault locating method for judging single phase-to-ground is proposed for Jinshan distribution network, and an intelligent management scheme of 10kV overhead lines is given, some intelligent devices are installed on some key points of overhead lines, such as digital fault indicator, comprehensive monitoring unit. It achieves the fault locating of overhead lines, and real-time monitoring of the load current and fault information, thus the information blind condition of overhead lines is changed, the efficiency of fault process is improved, and the intelligent management of overhead lines is realized.

articleTitle: Research on distribution automation standardized design and practical application
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In May 2009, SGCC (State Grid Corporation of China) has proposed the strategy of speeding up the development of smart electricity grid. As the corner stone of building the smart distribution network, distribution automation system development has been given high priority. SGCC has established two batches of 23 major cities for distribution automation pilot, all of which have been satisfactorily completed at this moment. This paper will combine the two batches of pilot construction and operation results and experiences, sorts out the whole process of construction and operation of distribution automation, elaborate on three key areas: technical route, standardization design and practical applications in distribution automation in the construction and operation. The standardization design which involves equipment modification, distribution master station, distribution communications network, distribution terminals, and information exchange; The practical application mainly introduces the application of distribution automation operation and maintenance, and to analysis a few key indicators of practical operation, such as master station operation rate, terminals operation rate. Finally, this paper provides proposals for the development of distribution automation.

articleTitle: Information interactive model of power grid and user-side devices
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, an information interactive model of power grid and user-side devices is designed, on the basis of studying and practicing smart grid interactive functions. First, block diagram of information interactive system model of power grid and user-side devices is given, and on the basis of it, smart grid user interface system architecture is extracted. Second, the realization process of information interaction is shown with the client/server model, and then the general communication service interface(GCSI) is put forward as well as the functional timing diagram of broadcasting.

articleTitle: Analysis of rural electric power demand based on VEC model
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the slowing down of domestic economy growth and the deteriorating of international economic environment, stimulating domestic demand becomes the major way of the economic growth of our country, and the maximum potential of stimulating domestic demand lies in the rural area. The question of how to analyze the requirement of electric power in rural areas precisely was meaningful to the adjustment of industrial structure, the increase of farmers' income. This paper is intended to make clear the definition and classification of rural area electric power consumption structure firstly, and then analyzing the main factors that influence on electric power demand in rural area, the annual data were taken from China Statistical Yearbook during the period 1980–2010, used variables are electricity consumed in rural areas, value-added of the primary industry, per capita net income of rural households, irrigated area and agricultural machinery total power in the analysis, next applying cointegration analysis, vector error correction model and Granger-causality test. The result shows that there exists a longrun stable relation between these variables, inefficient electric power use for agricultural production and electricity consumption of farming are more than rural residents. In the end, summarized the main conclusions and put forward proposals for development of electric power.

articleTitle: Application of the information from Hydropower Dispatch Automation System in the forewarning and control of the power system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Hydropower Dispatching Automation System (HDAS) has played a significant role in the online monitoring, hydropower dispatching and accidents precaution. This paper proposed a method for the advanced application of HDAS. Emphasis is placed on the algorithms for accident precaution and assistant decision-making, taking advantage of the information provided by HDAS and D5000. The algorithms proposed in this paper are also applied to develop a dispatch software package, which is employed in the dispatching automation system in Sichuan Power Grid. An example of the online application is used to verify the effectiveness of the methods.

articleTitle: The influences and countermeasures of transmission line differential protection AND AUTO-RECLOSing when wind farm connected
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Large-capacity wind power will have impact on transmission line protection and auto-reclosing when short circuit occurs. This paper analyses the characteristics of wind farm model and the influences of wind power to transmission line differential protection as well as its auto-reclosing, then proposed countermeasures to meet and overcome the problem.

articleTitle: Voltage sag characteristics and occurring frequency assessment considering the protection coordination
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Magnitude and duration are two main features used to characterize voltage sag. Many studies have been done in analyzing the factors that only impact the magnitude of the sag. As another feature of voltage sag, the duration is determined by the coordination of protection system. The fault caused voltage sag is usually assumed to be cleared by the primary protection system simply, the impact of protection coordination on sag duration is not considered by existing studies. In order to estimate voltage sag duration more precisely, this paper firstly uses the concept of Markov state space to establish the probabilistic modeling of protection coordination according to protection configuration, and then estimates sag frequency by utilizing the protection coordination probability and setting value of protection system. In addition, the proposed method was applied to the IEEE 57-bus test system, the simulation results show that the proposed method is simple and can give more accurate answers on voltage sag frequency corresponding to different duration.

articleTitle: The impact of wind power inverse-peaking characteristics on power system low frequency oscillation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the inverse-peaking characteristic, the variation of wind power daily output is in contrast to that of the load in power system. The output characteristic of wind power impacts the power system more obviously, with the contribution of interconnection of wind farm and large grid and the increasing penetration of wind power. The influence of the wind power inverse-peaking characteristic on the low frequency oscillation (LFO) calls for more and more concerns. Based on the complete model of the doubly fed induction generator(DFIG), eigenvalue analysis is applied to expect its impact on the power system low frequency oscillation in the WSCC 3-generator-9-bus system, respectively in the conditions of high and low load. The result shows that the damping of the modes strongly correlated to the DFIG is enhanced in low-load condition while weakened in high-load one.

articleTitle: Survey on research and application of stray kinetic energy
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Stray kinetic energy such as human walking, running, dancing and other daily activities, cars, trains and other vehicles on the road, water, air flow in the environment, spread and is a renewable and widespread green energy. If this discrete, stray energy can be harvested to generate electricity and use effectivly, it will be a new energy-saving technology and make an important contribution to adding energy sources and energy conservation. In this paper, the stray kinetic energy application has been as study object, and the research and application situations at home and abroad of various forms of kinetic energy have been investigated, the difficulties and problems in applications of kinetic energy which is important to apply stray kinetic energy at a wide range have been proposed.

articleTitle: A dynamic accident handling decision support system for regional power grid consider multi-constrains
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A dynamic grid accident handling decision support system was developed for regional power grid from 220kV high voltage stations to power distribution network considering multi-constraints such as power supply recovery time, system stability, power supply reliability, and power supply loss. The developed system is designed as layering structure for logical layer and demonstration layer. And the system automatically obtains the grid data from PMS system, SCADA system and CIS system. It is modelled with the method of classification by weight of load and users.
