The expert database for dispatch rules is refined according to the general dispatch protocol and the grid dispatch protocol of Shanghai; it adopts the algorithm of tree traversal in order to analyse the fault corresponding to dispatch protocol on the basis of the user specified fault equipment and whole grid data model and establishes optimized plan.

articleTitle: Discussion on the development trend of smart grid and its key technology
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Smart grid technology will fundamentally change the current distribution and electricity way, it not only helps to reduce the power demand, cost savings, but also can significantly improve power system reliability and efficiency. Smart grid using the new network technology, including can be used for real-time monitoring of power using a sensor and can be used to automatically change to reduce power consumption controller. However, the smart grid also brings security and privacy, large-scale distributed sensor management system and other complex issues. This paper introduces the concept of smart grid and functional characteristics of smart grid technology, summed up the research situation at home and abroad and the significance of developing smart grid. Based on the analysis of the smart grid, smart grid will be the development trend of modern power system. At the same time on the smart grid technology are reviewed in this paper, cited several key technologies of smart grid technologies, and points out the problems and challenges.

articleTitle: Research of market potential and policy mechanism on how power grid enterprises make roles in EV charging infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: New energy vehicle, especially the electric vehicle, has become the new model of environmental-friendly transportation tool in the world. One key factor of EV development is the improvement of constancy, stability, cost-efficiency, and engine efficiency of its power system. Battery producer, car manufacturer and electric power provider can all make great contributions to EV development by technology innovation and market cultivation. In China, considering the integrated management of power transmission and distribution, and high-centralized market, power provider takes a leading role in strategy making, position orienting and function designing in EV markets. This article aims to make theoretical and empirical study on how power grid enterprises tap market potential and make policy mechanism in EV charging infrastructure. Based on the examples from representative countries and cities, China's "Ten Cities, One Thousand EVs" project, and Shanghai's practical experience on EV development, this article focuses on the main obstacles during the commercialization of EV charging infrastructure: the uncertainty of market demand scale, the unclearness of cost - benefit details, as well as the irrationalities of price mechanism. Based on Nest-Logit model, this paper surveyed 3,500 Shanghai urban residents to study their demand preference on vehicle charging. The questionnaire clarifies income levels, education backgrounds, age structures and driving habits, and provides quantitative analysis of the elasticity and sensitive range of consumers for EV charging price. Taking "China Twelvfth Five-Year Plan" and "State Grid Charging Infrastructure Development General Plans" into account, this article makes demand forecasting of EV market and vehicle characteristics in recent Shanghai. Finally, the author offers a comprehensive social and economic cost-benefit accounting for EV market, and clarifies EV charging infrastructure investment scale, direct revenues and indirect returns, thus providing a useful backup and reference for power grid enterprises to make more scientific investment and financing plan, get stronger government policy supports and perform better risk management in EV charging construction. The result of this study has theoretical innovations and practicality as well, which supports the grid companies to optimize their industrial development schemes and chase the opportunities in the new energy vehicle industry development.

articleTitle: Implementation of IOC and its application in distribution system operation and maintenance management
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As smart grid is giving rise to the continuing growth of concern and research interest, it is expected to be able to provide a more intelligent way to operate the facilities in transmission and distribution systems and better benefit the utility companies. Meanwhile, development and application of new technologies enable managers of the utility company to monitor, supervise and optimize distribution network in a more comprehensively manner. On the other hand, distribution systems face new challenges in such a new environment that it requires for further development and implementation of the features while smart consumption of electricity is needed for both the utility companies and end users. This paper introduces IBM Intelligent Operations Centre (IOC) which includes incident management, integrated mapping and collaboration capabilities. In order to meet challenges in distribution network operation and maintenance(O&M) management, IOC is adapted to achieve centralized management of distribution system O&M. It integrates much functionality like measurement, monitoring and subsystems into a new platform and provides necessary information in a more effective way that enhances O&M management efficiency and contributes to coordination, cooperation and decision-making especially in emergency scenarios. The IOC deployment consists of GIS/SVG based global surveillance, event based cockpit and Key Performance Indices based cockpit. Finally, an application in HengQin power system proves the feasibility and validity of the IBM IOC in distribution system O&M management.

articleTitle: Development of Electric Vehicles: Opportunities and challenges for power grid companies
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Due to the electrification of powertrain system, the Electric Vehicle (EV) has significant advantages in energy conservation and environmental protection, and the industrialization of EV has speeded up globally. The demand of EV for the energy supply is essentially a new type of electricity demand, with the characteristics of mobility, diversity and dispatchability. The development of EVs, on the one hand, would provide an important opportunity for power grid companies to exploit the new market and find a new source of growth, and on the other hand, it would also bring the challenges to the power grid companies, such as to build and operate the swapping/charging service network for the EVs, to realize the smart charging management to obtain the maximum overall benefits, and to update the distribution networks to support the charging/swapping service network in an affordable, efficient and convenient way. The opportunities and challenges are systematically analyzed in this paper. Finally, the experiences of research and practice of State Grid Corporation of China in charging/swapping service network are introduced, and the suggestions for the power grid companies to develop a charging/swapping service network are proposed..

articleTitle: A new evaluation system for energy-saving effect based on extended energy consumption and extended energy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The paper analyzes current researches on energy saving and evaluation of energy efficiency as well as the status of their applications. Based on the in-depth analysis and detailed study on energy consumption and energy efficiency, this paper put forward the concept of target energy and the concepts of working energy consumption, early energy consumption and extended energy consumption, expounding their relationship meanwhile; gives definition of working energy efficiency and extended energy efficiency, as well as makes detailed research and mathematical analysis on their physical meaning and essential law. On the basis of those indexes, a new evaluation system for the effect of energy saving measures is established, after which the practical calculation and application of extended energy consumption and extended energy efficiency are expounded, using the example of upgrading the rural power grids. The new evaluation system established in the paper can reflect the overall energy-saving effect more scienctifically and actually, leading to new recognization of energy-saving measures' factual effect. And it is conducive to promote new ideas and new indexes for more perfect evaluation of energy saving. Also, the new evaluation system has some significance to guiding energy-saving measures and optimizing the effect of energy saving to an extent, conducive to the progress of energy-saving technology and the improvement of energy-saving level.

articleTitle: Low-voltage power line channel environment and the application analysis in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: PLC (power line communication) technology is widely used in smart grid, this article details the power line channel characteristics of the environment, and its noise model can be divided into five categories. With analyzing their causes, bandwidth and respective property, we compare the advantages and disadvantages of the broadband and narrowband PLC technology in terms of the communication performance. And the major application scenarios in smart grid were divided into three different types: power information collection and the monitoring of electrical equipment, indoor devices interconnecting for smart home and broadband access. We are focusing on the topology and technical characteristics in the electric energy data acquisition system. Finally, the paper investigated the requirement of electric energy data acquisition system in China for smart grid.

articleTitle: Research on multiple Svcs allocation method considering operation mode changing
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Taking operation mode changing and combined influence of multiple SVCs on power system into account, a multiple SVCs allocation method is proposed in this paper. This method is presented through normal form analysis, and based on the information provided by second-order analytical solution of perturbation equation. This method includes three steps: Firstly, the most critical operation mode, which is the closest to voltage collapse of the system, should be determined based on static voltage stability analysis. Secondly, in this critical mode, the small signal stability analysis should be made on the perturbation equation of certain power system, and then analytical solutions of all the PQ buses could be obtained by using normal form. Finally, using first-order and second-order oscillation amplitudes of the second-order analytic solutions, the multiple SVCs locations can be determined, with an index of reducing perturbation amplitudes. Comparing to those methods which do not consider the influences of multiple SVCs, the proposed method has a better performance on static voltage stability margins expanding. The IEEE 30-bus power system will be used to prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: The research on comprehensive benefits evaluation of smart grid self-healing
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The research on comprehensive benefits evaluation of smart distribution grid self-healing, mainly analyzed the effects from technology, economic, society and practicality. By this method, it could express the benefits of this program totally. For example, to power users, this project could improve the power quality. To society, it may increase the whole social welfare. To Adjacent power grid, it strengthens the reality of entire power grid, etc. All of them show the comprehensive benefits of power grid self-healing project. Therefore, firstly, based on the quasi-public goods and monopoly features of this project, it built the externality matrix by welfare economic and externality theories. From this matrix, it showed the influences of social economic and other objects under this program. Then, considering the SMART measure and principle of “practical, objective, typical and comprehensive”, it proposed series indexes by LCAM method, created comprehensive evaluation system by triangle fuzzy function. This system related to the aspects of technology, economic, society and practicality, it included over 20 quantity and quality indexes from the series conditions, such as safe, reality, economical, low-cost, social environment and target achievement. The method was examined by an example. According to this system, it could promote foundation for objective judgment of power grid self-healing project.

articleTitle: A survey of communication technology in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the development of the smart grid technology, power distribution network puts forward a higher request for transmission bandwidth and reliability. First, we analyze the characteristics and the business needs of the distribution network. Then we analyze the distribution network communication technologies, both wired and wireless. Based on our analysis, we should combine various communication technologies according to the comprehensive economic and technical indexes in power distribution automation communication system.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of electrical distribution system considering the random energy output of wind power generators
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A novel network model and a fast algorithm for electrical distribution system (EDS) reliability evaluation considering the random energy output of wind power generators (WPG) are presented in this paper. Firstly, a Switch-Section network model is proposed according to the failure isolation characteristics of switches, and then the Switch-Section network is divided into two kinds of parts, main-network and branch-network, based on the property of the power flow direction when WPG are unavailable. Secondly, the concept of energy influence domain (EID) is proposed in order to consider the random wind energy impact on the power supply range of WPG. Based on this concept, we construct the power supply order which successfully implemented the mapping between the random output of WPG and the supply probability to the sections in the EID. Finally, the reliability indices of the main-network and branch-network are calculated by using properties of elements in upstream and downstream fault propagation. Meanwhile, the impacts of WPG on the sections of its EID are considered when computing the nodal downstream reliability indices. The application of the proposed method to the RBTS-BUS6 demonstrates its validity. And the impacts of the position, load demand characteristics, rated capacity of WPG and wind speed on system reliability are also discussed in detail in this paper which will provide some constructive suggestions to WPG installation.

articleTitle: The constructive situation and developing direction of the electricity consumption information collection system in China
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Conforming to the development direction of international grid technology, the construction of electricity consumption information collection system is both an important part of building a unified and smart grid and critical basic system of intelligent electricity consumption service. Its technical advancement will directly involve with energy availability factor of smart grid and effect of economy operation. The paper introduces the framework and construction methods of electricity consumption information collection system, analyzes the current situation and obtained effectiveness in China and predicts future developing trend of electricity consumption information collection system.

articleTitle: Plan and practice of smart power consumption in Shanghai urban area
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Shanghai is one of China's highest levels of industrialization and most economically developed regions. In the backdrop of the development of smart grid, smart electric power industry will be to play a very important position in the Shanghai urban area's electric power industry. This paper will focus on the analysis of the present situation of Shanghai urban area's power grid, especially the basic skills and business models of the power demand side. It is researched that the blueprint of the Shanghai urban area's future power grid and achieving methods based on the related smart electricity work carried on in the current Shanghai urban area and its effectiveness, especially, the pilot project. The main work is as follows: the description of the current Shanghai urban area power grid, including the history, development and evolution, load characteristics level, reliability, power distribution automation level and so on. The presented situation of smart power, which mainly includes the information collection system pilot project, electric vehicle charging facilities pilot project, intelligent building pilot project, flexible DC power transmission pilot project, the power FTTH (Fiber to The Home) to households pilot project, especially combine with the smart grid key pilot projects, such as the smart power design and practice of Shanghai World Expo smart grid pilot projects, and point out the current shortage and inadequate of the smart grid. The blueprint and achieving methods of the smart electricity describes the design blueprint of the future smart electricity in Shanghai urban area, and the means and direction to realize, such as to adapt and promote clean energy development, realizing highly smart grid dispatching to meet the electric vehicle and other new electricity consumers of electricity service requirements, efficient use and life cycle management of grid assets, convenient interaction between power users and grid, grid management informationalization and delicacy and playing the role of value-added services potential of the grid infrastructure.

articleTitle: Parameter design and simulation for the main circuit of Unified power quality controller (UFQC) with large capacity
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Unified power quality controller has broad prospects in the future applications. Due to the lack of main circuit and parameter design method of Unified power quality controller (UPQC) with large capacity, In this paper, UPQC series (left) parallel (right), which is the most common structure will be taken as an example, static state mathematical model will be analyzed; Based on static state mathematical model, main circuit parameter design method of UPQC with large capacity will be investigated. Parallel/series side converter, parallel/series commutating transformer, dc capacitor and other major parameter design method is proposed. The correctness of the model and the main circuit parameters has been verified by simulation analysis, which provides solid foundation for manufacturing large capacity UPQC industrial prototype.

articleTitle: Information security of power corporations and its reinforcement measures
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Information system security of power corporations is mainly exposed to physics security risk, network security risk, application security risk and management security risk. The success of information security normally relies on 30% technology support but 70% management investment. Therefore, rigid management plays a crucial role in threat prevention. After a critical summery of the current research on power information system security technology and security management home and abroad, the paper points out a necessary emphasis on information security of production control system and Internet power information system and security management in the future, based on the features and requirements of power information system. First of all, the paper reviews information security and its classification. Then it puts forwards corresponding strategies based on the analysis of various risks, such as network equipment security reinforcement, service security reinforcement, and application security reinforcement. Meanwhile, it gives an introduction of physics security, data security prevention and management regulations.

articleTitle: Power supply & storage capability index of smart grid and its application
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In distribution network, the interconnection of distributed energy storage system (DESS) provides network with supply & storage capability which is conducive to regulate peak load and solve intermittency of intermittent energy source. DESS power supply & storage capability index is proposed to quantitatively describe the time-varied maximum power supply and storage capability of DESS, considering the effect caused by interconnection of DESS and the constraint of electrical network and DESS. The supply & storage capability index's effectiveness is verified under the context of DESS optimal economic scheduling.

articleTitle: Study and practice on the construction of demonstration area on power supply's high-reliability in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Power supply reliability means the power system's ability in sustainable power supplying, which is a main index in evaluating the quality of power supply system. As the quick development of society and economic, the customers in urban area has an increasing demand on higher power reliability, especially in Yuzhong district located in Chongqing's core zone, which is administrative center, financial center, business center, information center, culture center, the upland of basic education, medical and health institutions, and the passenger transportation hub of land and water. Therefore Chongqing Power Corporation make part of this area as demonstration of State Grid Corporation on power supply high-reliability. The construction of this demonstration area mainly include reliability evaluation on distribution grid, reliability planning on grid structure, reconstruction on distribution grid, risk analysis on distribution grid operation, production and command platform construction, construction of standard operation and management system on regional distribution with high reliability, etc.. After using the distribution grid reliability assessment method based on risk theory to find the weak areas of distribution grid, the ring network optimization, equipment modification and improvements, methods of information support, measures of management and technology were proposed. Through the information exchange bus, distribution automation system, production management system (PMS), 95598 system, geographic information system (GIS), reliability risk assessment system, online-monitoring system and condition-based maintenance system were integrated. With the application of production command platform, production and management processes were refined and optimized, not only the recovery average processing time was reduced significantly, but the process of distribution grid maintenance and recovery can be monitored. After the construction of high reliability demonstration area, the reliability index increased from 99.96% to 99.9991%, service quality on power supply and customers' satisfaction also increased significantly, and consequently good society and commercial benefit were made.

articleTitle: JVC integrated supervisory control system of micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Micro-grid is a small low-voltage system composed of distributed generation, energy storage and load. Behaving as a single autonomous control unit relative to the external grid, it can operate either on or off grid, thus satisfies users' requirements of power quality and supply security. As the core control technology of micro-grid, the integrated monitoring technology,which covers the micro-grid coordination control and energy management technology, guarantees the “autonomy” and “friendly” performance of micro-grid. The design framework of a typical micro-grid integrated supervisory control system, whose basic functions and advanced applications are briefly discussed, was introduced in this paper. On this basis, the designed CIM modeling tools for micro-grid, anti-disturbance control strategy and charge/discharge planning control strategy for energy-storage was given. The on-site operation showed that the supervisory control system could work well and meet the requirements of security operation.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of turbine speed governing system by using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The speed governing system is one of the main control systems of the turbine, the accurate model and parameter have great significance to the power system simulation calculation. The genetic algorithm(GA) is used for the parameter identification of the speed governing system in this paper. The best individual replacement is used to make the convergence rate of the algorithm faster. The type 4 governing PSASP model is developed for testing the GA with MATLAB and Simulink. The result proves the GA can achieve the parameter identification which has high simulation precision.

articleTitle: Control strategy of microgrid with different types of DG and its dynamical simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper mathematical models and control method of DGs in microgrid are researched, and a typical integrated model of microgrid is created by DIgSILENT, according to an experimental microgrid in Beijing. The effect on stability of microgrid operation caused by two typical microgrid operating conditions including disconnection from the main grid and PV output drop in island mode are simulated, with the changes in output of DGs, system voltage and frequency analyzed. Validity of the proposed model and its control strategy is simulation-examined..

articleTitle: Can China MV networks also benefit from the latest 2SIS fixed MV switchgear technology?
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: China MV distribution network architecture makes extensive use of MV/MV switching substations with circuit breaker functions. Although KYN type panels are the most commonly used today, there is a trend towards greater use of fixed VCB panels (XGN type) as customers realise that they have many advantages in terms of reliability, cost and footprint required. It is expected that if this trend will continue, making fixed type VCB the predominant type in China MV switchgear market by 2020. This paper describes an innovative design of shielded solid insulation switchgear (2SIS) using fixed vacuum circuit breaker panels. The 2SIS technology brings many new customer benefits compared to AIS withdrawable and fixed VCB cubicles, including reduced dimensions, harsh environment withstand, higher reliability, lower maintenance requirement and higher operator safety..

articleTitle: Research of a new transformer fault diagnosis expert system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to improve safety and economy of the power transformer operation, and guide operator deal with transformer abnormal condition, as well as how to find out the fault causes of the malfunction quickly, In this paper, a new power transformer fault diagnosis expert system was established. The system first uses rough set method and expert experience to simplify the knowledge of fault sample database, eliminate redundant information, form refined rules and input them into the knowledge base of the expert system. During the fault reasoning, the diagnosis or corresponding processing scheme are obtained by analyzing the matching between existing quantity of state of the transformer and the rules in the knowledge base. The example analysis shows, this system can effectively guide the working staff.

articleTitle: Inrush current on transformer differential protection affect the analysis and discussion
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper,based on the characteristics of transformer inrush current waveform analysis of the protection of its reliability and its high-pressure differential between trial. Together with a large transformer (voltage rating of 500kV) of the differential protection analysis of actual cases, their first-hand data and field research and analysis of test waveforms and found that in order to avoid inrush current caused the error transformer differential protection movement, on-site technical staff conducting differential protection setting process, notonly the parameters used, the data comply with the relevant rules and standards, Shu Xi differential protection features, but also must understand the high-pressure test on the transformer inrush current characteristics effects, and even more fully to play the modern computer equipment recorded the role of wave devices to increase as much as possible the actual effect of transformer differential protection.

articleTitle: Study on promoting integration of large scale wind employed the 750kV controllable shunt reactor
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: By the end of 2010, the 750kV double circuit power transmission project from Dunhuang to Wusheng in Gansu had been put into operation, aimed at promoting the integration of large scale wind power, and solving the technology and practical problems caused by the intensively exploitation and long-distance transmission of the wind power. But the transportability of the power transmission line was impacted seriously by the frequent and large-amplitude fluctuations of the reactive power and voltage, and the bus voltage is more difficult to control. The 750kV controllable shunt reactor (CSR) which has been operated in Dunhuang substation of Gansu in 2011 provides a very efficient technological means of solving these problems. The super grid of Hexi of Gansu paralleled with the CSR is modelled in this paper. The action situation of the CSR and the influence to the system reactive power and voltage are studied, when the capacity of integrated wind power changes. The integrated capacity was measured at Dunhuang substation, the actual result of the CSR to promote the integration of the large scale wind power is revealed qualitatively and quantitatively.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the evaporative cooling system in a low-noise power transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Decades of experience in underground substations indicated that the traditional cooling technologies have their own various shortcomings. Therefore, a novel evaporative cooling system was pointed out and will be applied in a power transformer of an urban substation. This new cooling technology could be considered as a two-step cooling system, which could transport heat energy effectively from underground thermal sources to the parallel finned tubes assembled in the transformer tank, and the evaporative coolant in parallel finned tubes absorbs heat and changes from liquid into vapor, then the vapor condenses back into liquid in the radiators on the ground. Furthermore, the cooling system is self-circulated, needing no additional pump or fans. A 2500W experimental model is designed, fabricated and tested, and the testing result shows that the top oil temperature rise meet the requirement of Chinese National Standard of GB 1094.2-1996 and the relevant IEC 60076-2-2011, which proves the feasibility of the new transformer cooling technology. Next, a transformer prototype will be fabricated and put into operation.

articleTitle: The discussion about the application and development for the distribution automation system in Jinan Power Supply Company
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The article compares the two distribution automation systems built 10 years before with now in Jinan Power Supply Company. The old distribution automation system put into operation in July 2002, named iES-DMS1000. From the actual use and maintenance of this system, we summarize the problems of this system. Learn from the experience and lessons of the old distribution network systems, we state the construction of the intelligent distribution automation system building in Jinan Power Supply Company now. Breaking the previous systems' construction of island, it can come true that many related information systems can interconnect with each other in the new distribution system. That is the innovation for Control Integration, connecting the various systems with the new distribution automation system, In the end of this article, we abstract the characteristics and experiences of the distribution automation system building in the Jinan Power Supply Company now. And we set up the experience and recommendations of the system setup and maintenance.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic interference due to HVDC transmission line faults
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper presents a study of electromagnetic interference to pipelines due tonearby 500 kV HVDC transmission line faults.While there is a large volume of publications addressing the issues of alternating EMI issues, the authors are not aware of publicly available publications addressing the issues of inductive interference from HVDC lines under fault conditions. The objective of this paper is to fill in this gap.The study focuses on magnetic (inductive) interference to the pipelines caused by the transient nature of the fault current. Modelling techniques for this type of studies are described and computation results for the induced potential on a pipeline during a fault are presented.

articleTitle: FEM simulation of temperature field of dry-type transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In order to calculate winding temperature of dry-type transformer in accurate way, it is necessary to base on the theory of heat transfer and the theory of hydrodynamics and carry out simulation computation on winding temperature distribution of dry-type transformer by means of FLUENT software. We take the winding temperature of 3 dry-type transformers with different capacity as an illustration. Through comparison between High and low voltage winding temperature, the calculation and test results show that all errors range from -4K to 0K. This calculation method can accurately compute winding temperature and its distribution location and provide the basis for design, research and development and operational maintenance of similar products.

articleTitle: Research on primary frequency regulation of system with volatility of wind power
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The access of wind power will bring frequency fluctuation to power system, the performance of system's primary frequency regulation (PFR) has an important effect on the stable operation of the grid. In this paper, the ability of system's primary frequency regulation is studyed after wind farm connected to grid. First, the paper forecasts wind speed by time sequence method, and establishes ARMA model of wind speed, then gets the forecasted wind power. Second, the wind farm output in short time interval is analyzed by cubic spline interpolation method. Finally, the paper establishes PFR mathematical model, and discusses the dynamic and static responses of system frequency with the change of wind power in short time and long time. The results provide a reference on the system's acceptance of wind power.

articleTitle: A new method for estimation of harmonics and inter-harmonics
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A new harmonic and inter-harmonic parameter estimation method is proposed in this paper based on several useful algorithms including modern cross-spectrum, total least square, the rotational invariance and improved prony algorithm. In additional, the basic characteristics of noise signals of being independent principle at different time and the zero average value in sampling period are involved in this method. The proposed method has been simulated conditioned upon low signal noise ratio, and the results have shown that this new method can accurately and effectively identify the frequency, amplitude and initial phase of all harmonic and inter-harmonic signals.

articleTitle: Comparative study Of 10kV distribution network structure based on Life Cycle Cost analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: For a long time, the 10 kV distribution network is gradually built up with the increase of load demand. There's a lack of systematic planning and standardized construction in its structure. Combining local economic development level, grid situation, load characteristics and other factors, the distribution network in some developed areas formed typical structure with local characteristics. But the rationality of the structure has not been systematically demonstrated, especially in lack of quantified conclusion in economy and reliability. This paper introduces the concept of Life Cycle Cost and builds the 10 kV distribution network entire life cycle cost analysis model taking into account the reliability of power supply. On this basis, with full consideration of the load density, line load rate, construction costs, equipment life and many other factors, this paper comparatively studies the reliability and economy of typical structures of overhead network and cable network, and then gets cost difference of typical structures under different load density conditions.

articleTitle: Experiences with IEC61850 a US case study
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The advent of the IEC61850 Standard has ushered in a new age for substation automation. This standard has gained a very strong footing in Europe, and its application is spreading across the world. In the USA, the progress towards IEC 61850 implementation is relatively slower. IEC 61850 holds great promises for substation automation and protection. There are many advantages that IEC61850 brings to the area of protection and automation in the form of ease of data collection, reduced construction and design costs, and interoperability between various multi-vendor IEDs. Although this standard is viewed as being very useful and cost-effective, there are several new challenges posed by the implementation of this standard in the US. Issues that concern utilities in the US include the level of cyber security that this standard provides. At this point, the IEC 61850 in the US is limited to the walls of the substation. For the present time, the cyber security issues are within the regulation imposed by the various regulating agencies in the USA. Another issue that is very critical is the new techniques and tools required for commissioning a substation that has multi-vendor IEDs. This main thrust of this paper is to highlight some of the installation and commissioning issues that were encountered during one of the pilot projects at a utility in the US. This pilot project involved the First IEC 61850 substation built in the USA with multi vendor IEDs. There were several challenges that the commissioning team had to face, and it was a learning experience for everybody involved. This paper will highlight all the experiences associated with making this First IEC 61850 substation a great success in the US. This paper will consist of four sections. The First section will cover the hardware needed to support the IEC61850 communication over a TCP/IP network. The second section will explain what and how IEC61850 GOOSE works. This section will include an example of a line relay application. It will also cover the security aspects of using IEC61850 for substation control and protective relay applications. The third section will cover testing the individual measuring units in the relays, and the overall protection scheme tests. The fourth section is about lessons learned during the initial design and substation commissioning.

articleTitle: LabVIEW based data management design for EV Bi-directional charger test system implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Electric Vehicle (EV) bi-directional charger as an important part of the industrial chain for EV can realize two-way power conversion and interaction between EV power battery and power grid. In this paper, a scientific integrated approach to data management in the process of implementing test system for EV bi-directional charger is presented. Combined with the file system and database technology in the LabVIEW environment, this data management mode has centralized and unified process large numbers of test data and system information. Moreover, it can provide data management support for test report and results analysis. By performing the application for test system operation, it has indicated that data management platform will be beneficial to integrate test resources, improve resource utilization, expand the freedom of managing test data, and efficient to reflect the performance of EV bi-directional charger.

articleTitle: Exploring the use value of air conditioners in residential peak demand response
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Demand-side Management (DSM) based on the Smart Grid directing to various electrical appliances in the household will contribute to improved demand-side response and cost-effective policy. Evaluating the use value of different electrical end uses and analyzing associated characteristics of population in the household side will provide basic information for the Integrated Resource Planning (IRP). This paper takes the residential air-conditioner as an example, and applies the Contingent Valuation Method (CVM) to investigate its use value during summer peak load in Xi'an City, China. Four controlling scenarios are considered. The study reveals that the value is quite different among the surveyed population, and a large proportion of people are ready to accept control with a small amounts of compensation. These people have a series of characteristics such as high level of education, energy-saving, and so on.

articleTitle: A novel mechanism of channel allocation for power distribution in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A distributed wireless channel allocation mechanism is introduced in this paper. Wireless channel can be allocated to the interrupted UE in a distributed way with a dynamic priority. This allocation scheme is scalable for deployment in large networks as only with the localized information. Moreover, the performance of our allocation scheme is demonstrated by the numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A comprehensive evaluation method for distribution networks' disaster vulnerability based on group AHP
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation method for distribution networks' disaster vulnerability, illustrated by the case of lightning to help the decision-makers operate the differential planning for distribution networks against disasters scientifically. This paper is divided into three parts: first of all, detail analysis is made to establish an evaluation indicators system of distribution networks' lightning vulnerability; second, expound the method of calculating the Lightning Vulnerability of local distribution network by Group Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and the principle on networks' planning zoning against lightning; finally, in the planning example of a distribution network, results shows that, it is able to assess the networks' lightning vulnerability by the proposed method, which provides a quantitative reference when operating differential planning against disasters.

articleTitle: A heuristic method for optimal placement and monitoring of renewable energy DG
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The optimal placement and power level of the different types of generation units is a non-convex optimization problem. The technology modeling of renewable energy distribute generation of wind and photovoltaic were introduced, and a heuristic method for the optimal placement and monitoring of renewable energy distributed generators at the sub-transmission and distribution levels of the electric power network was proposed in the paper. A test system with DGs is used to prove the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on 35kV Cascaded Statcom and ITS application
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A Cascaded transformerless Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM) of 35kV/8Mvar has been successfully developed and putted into application. The STATCOM is self-excited and in star configuration, each phase consists of twenty-one units, which employees 3.3kV IGBTs. With power supply by itself and the adjacent one, each unit can be bypassed and thus implement N-1 redundant running. By optimized Carrier Phase-Shift PWM method, the frequency of STATCOM can be dropped as low as 275Hz with the efficiency as high as 99%. Based on high speed distributed digital processors and instant current control method, the device has realized synthesized voltage and reactive power regulation and VQC/AVC coordination. The response time of STATCOM is below 10ms when voltage sag detected, thus strongly sustain the power system voltage. The experimental data and the field operation results both show that the performances of the developed transformerless 35kV/8Mvar STATCOM are satisfied, which provides a new solution for voltage and reactive power control for electric power substation.

articleTitle: Study on application of hybrid active power filter into harmonic suppression and reactive power compensation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In shunt HAPF, the PPF and APF are in series connection and then in parallel with loads; the PPF is mainly used to eliminate the main order harmonic currents and compensate reactive power, and APF is used to improve the compensating performance and flexibility and prevent resonant phenomenon. In ideal situations, through appropriate control, the fundamental voltage of the common point with HAPF connected can mainly drop on PPF, and only harmonic voltage drops on APF, which can greatly reduce the APF capacity and then reduce the cost of whole compensating device, and benefit the extensive application of HAPF. The operating principles of shunt HAPF are detailed in this paper. Based on present study, the APF capacities of common used HAPFs are analyzed, and common used HAPFs with different topologies are compared. Finally, simulation model of certain HAPF is built, and through detailed simulation results, the harmonic suppression and reactive power compensation performance of HAPF is verified.

articleTitle: A research of feeder protection 10kV distribution neteorks including distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: More and more distributed generation(DG)is being connected into distribution network with the development of power grid. The connection of DG will impact the feeder protection directly. It may lead to loss of protection's selectivity or decrease of protection sensitiveness. More badly, the protection may refuse to act or act mistakenly. In this paper a practical distribution network with DG which exists in the power grid of SHINAN Power Supply Company is proposed. Based on this example grid, what impact the DG brings to the feeder protection and how it affects the feeder protection are studied deeply. An improved protection scheme is proposed considering the impact of DG. New protection scheme includes two major changes. Firstly directional unit is added to the feeder protection which may act mistakenly. Secondly, two sets of setting value are applied to some feeders' protection and the protection can switch to one or the other setting value depending on whether DG is interconnected to the distributed network. An ATP model of the example distributed network is built and a large number of simulations are made which covers all fault situations which may occur in the network. The simulation result indicates the proposed protection scheme can meet all of the need in protection sensitiveness and selective ability. In summary, the new protection scheme can solve the problem that the connection of DG brought to distribution network's feeder protection.

articleTitle: A all-in-one distriution automation system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The access of distribution generation(DG) presented new challenges to the operation and protection of power system with the development of the smart power distribution network. The Wiring structure changes from a single power supply into a double-Power or more power. As a result,it brings impact to distributed protection. The result shows the size of DG affects protection and makes it lose selectivity probably, DG upstream protection makes it amplify protection range, DG downstream protection makes it reduce protection range. In response to the problem, this paper proposes a new scheme, which is based on the centralized processing module on the distributed protection. Firstly, a smart unit is installed in the switch, which is only responsible for monitoring and control, merging unit and smart terminal unit function, and then sample information and DI information are sent to the distribution automation system through the fiber-optic communications. And then the automation system complete protection monitoring and control functions. Through utilizing the site-wide information collected on the distribution network to achieve network-wide protection, monitoring and control functions, it improves the reliability of the distributed protection operation. Compared with the conventional system, this scheme has more flexibility and more reliability on the coordination and the whole property. It is closer to the develop direction Of the distributed networks. easier to transform into the intelligent distributed networks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of residual service life of high voltage circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: It makes evaluation of residual service life on the high voltage circuit breaker more difficult, because of the uncertainty (fuzziness, randomness) and complexity of high voltage circuit breaker life influencing factors, so this paper presents a service life assessment model based on fuzzy reliability. The fuzziness and randomness of the parameter characteristics about high voltage circuit breaker are analysed, the distribution function and the fuzzy membership function of the parameters are obtained. With the online monitoring datas, using the random theory and the fuzzy theory calculate the fuzzy reliability of high voltage circuit breaker. For maintenance of high voltage circuit breaker causing data mutation, this paper uses a improved gray GIM (1, 1) prediction method based on the step data sequence, it realizes to predict the residual service life of high voltage circuit breaker. Finally, using SF6 high voltage circuit breaker as the example, verifies the rationality of the remaining life assessment model of high voltage circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Design of an intelligent low-voltage power capacitor
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As to the disadvantages of large size, complex internal structure, bad maintainability, inflexible application of the traditional reactive power compensation devices, a new intelligent low-voltage power capacitor based on LPC2388 processor is proposed, which takes the power factor and reactive power as the controlling quantity while considering the effect of voltage. The device can achieve the functions of zero-cross switching of capacitor, including turning on the switch while the voltage is zero and turning off the switch while the current is zero. With the control strategy of seven-zone diagram, it can effectively prevent the concussion of switching and realize fast and accurate switching of capacitor. Different devices can communicate with each other by RS485. Users can choose the type and quantity of this device to form low voltage reactive compensation equipment satisfying with various load requirements. The experiment results show that, the device proposed in this paper can reduce reactive power effectively and can play an important role in reducing reactive loss in the power line and improving the security of power grid.

articleTitle: Study on the behaviors of electric power consumers in smart grid environment
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As one of the stirring direction of research and development in power grid, the construction of smart grid is thought to be a revolution of electric power industry. And two-way interactive communication between the grid and power consumers will be an important part of the power consumption business in the future. As we know, different consumption behaviors of power consumers will bring different influences both on the safe operation of power grid and the economic of consumers. In this paper, the behavior characteristics of different power users of smart grid environment is full taking into account, and the types of energy saving, interactive service guiding, and new service requiring classification method is proposed based on the theory of consumer's behavior and customer marketing. Point to different development potentials of power consumers in smart service fields presently, the preferential development of energy-saving services to the industrial users is put forward. Meanwhile, the commercial operation model research on the intelligent power consumption filed should be developed as soon as possible. Finally, an energy serving case proposed in the paper proved the feasibility and correctness of the findings.

articleTitle: Legislative background, characteristics and improvement of Chinese Regulations on Emergency Handling, Investigation and Disposal of Electric Power Safety Accidents
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Regulations on Emergency Handling, Investigation and Disposal of Electric Power Safety Accidents is the first administrative regulation which regulates emergency handling, investigation and disposal of electric power safety accidents. It marks that electric power safety supervision and management in China have embarked on the road to legalization. The Regulations on Emergency Handling, Investigation and Disposal of Electric Power Safety Accidents rank the accidents, adjust the criteria for ranking accidents, specify the right of accident investigation and disposal, define the legal responsibilities and give clearer and more specific regulations based on the characteristics of the electric power industry.

Author Keywords: Investigation and Disposal of Electric Power Safety Accidents

articleTitle: Affection of power system relay cooperation to voltage sag and sensitive equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: When the power system component faults, the voltage sag duration depends on the cooperation time of protection system. Many literatures have analyzed the influencing factors of voltage sag magnitude, such as fault types, fault location, pre-fault voltage, transformer connections, and fault impedance. But the affection of protection cooperation to sag duration is not considered in detailed. A probabilistic modeling of the cooperation of the protection system is proposed based on the concept of Markov state space to estimate the sag duration. After that, the voltage sag frequency and sensitive equipment trip probability are estimated by utilizing the configuration and setting value of the protection system. The proposed method was applied to the IEEE 57-bus test system, and the simulation results show that the proposed method is practical, simple and adaptive, and the study of this paper has both theoretical significance and engineering application value for voltage sag frequency assessment.

articleTitle: Research on simulations and model of the isolated Wind-Solar-Diesel-Battery hybrid micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The disturbance defending ability of the isolated micro-grid is weak, and the randomness and the weak controllability of new energy generation are harmful to system stability. So a completed and accurate model of the isolated micro-grid is needed to do research on key technologies. This paper proposes an operating mode for the isolated micro-grid. A PSCAD simulation model of the isolated micro-grid with wind-solar-diesel-battery hybrid power generation is built based on the operating mode. The model parameters are obtained by parameter identification method. The feasibility and the effectiveness of the proposed approach are proved by simulation and model of an island planning micro-grid.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle charging power technology and operations management
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The development of electric vehicles electric vehicle charging electric technology and business model support. Electric vehicle charging and discharging load obvious imbalance, random and intermittent; electric vehicles to access the grid, can also be used as distributed power, to participate in the operation of the grid, the power transmission grid, which will also have the stability of the grid system with to the hidden dangers, to cope with new situations and new problems, it is necessary to charge and discharge of electric car technology and its charge management system of research and innovation. Traditional electricity sales business model, can not adapt to a variety of charging needs, is not conducive to the sustainable development of the electric service charge exchange, government regulation, corporate innovation, the establishment of the business model, all play a huge role in the development of electric vehicles<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>.

Author Keywords: the integration of mobile electric power operations network

articleTitle: Innovative MV switchgear for today's applications
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Historically switchgear evolution happened every 20 or 30 years. Every element of switchgear, switching devices, current and voltage transformers, protection relays and general architecture have evolved more or less in parallel. In recent years, the development of Smart Grids has brought in new challenges and ultimately new needs that have to be considered when designing the next generation of switchgear. Distribution network operators express strong interests in: reliability, cost-effectiveness, simplicity and ease of network evolution, while never compromising on safety. This paper reviews the MV switchgear evolution and future trends, coming to the conclusion that an optimized solution for many applications is a modular and compact MV switchgear with three position scheme and Shielded Solid Insulation System (2SIS).

articleTitle: A novel distance protection principle
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The features of time difference-based traveling wave distance protection is presented first, then the basic principle of traveling wave distance protection is analyzed comprehensively. The core components, including traveling wave head extraction method and GPS timing part are analyzed in detail, using polarity information of traveling wave to distinguish internal faults from external faults and the method of avoiding voltage dead zone are proposed, and the factors that affect the protection are considered. All these techniques make it possible to research and develop time difference-based traveling wave distance protection device.

articleTitle: Analysis of excessive noise in transformer substations
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Based on the noise characteristics of the two substations in urban areas, we adopt the advanced technologies for noise elimination and sound insulation. Noise reduction procedures are conducted on the field, making the noise within emission limit specified in the national law of environment protection.

articleTitle: Study on improved out-of-step splitting criterion based on the PMU
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: U cosφ out-of-step criterion was studied in this paper. It is found that U cosφ criterion can only partially capture the variation of the oscillation center voltage, so a method using PMU devices to measure both ends of the bus voltage phase angle difference as a secondary criterion combined with U cosφ criterion is proposed to locate of step oscillation center accurately. equivalent two-machine system model is established to verify the out-of-step based on both ends of the bus voltage phase angle difference by PSCAD simulation tools. The results show that the method can take advantage of the multiport measurement to recognize the out-of-step system state timely so that the contact line can be break reasonably and quickly.

articleTitle: Economic evaluation of 20KV distribution schemes based on multi-grey target theory
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In view of the growing urban power load and load density as well as the present situation of urban distribution network in China, the rationality of using 20kV voltage system is analyzed in economic aspect in this paper. The problem of how to reflect the economy of distribution schemes and the composition of this are analyzed, based on which an economic model is established. The paper designs a comprehensive index system including the year cost of high voltage distribution transformer, medium voltage distribution network and medium voltage distribution transformer in a quantitative way to evaluate the economical efficiency. Based on multi-grey target model, the different simulated 20kV distribution schemes are comprehensively evaluated. The case proves the feasibility of the economic model which provides references for development of 20kV distribution network in the future.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the sequence of voltage levels based on low-carbon theory
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the increased pressure of the power energy saving, Low carbon electricity is needed rapid development in the context of low-carbon economy nowadays. This will be low-carbon benefits as a starting point and shows the low-carbon emission reduction pathway from the grid side in this paper. Meanwhile, there can be reduced network losses by optimizing the sequence of voltage levels. From the conservation of energy conversion point of view, it should reference SE-DEA (super efficiency data envelopment analysis) algorithm advantage, and can get these evaluation index which meet comprehensive targets and avoid the coupling of target. Including the network size of the power grid, the total power loss, the total investment costs, power grid reliability and an area size, technical and economic comprehensive evaluation index system is established. In this paper the SE-DEA algorithm is applied to the field of program evaluation sequence voltage level, and evaluation process of Voltage level sequence is initially proposed. Finally, the model is applied the example of Zhengzhou New Area, When the load density of 2.5 MW/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 5 MW/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 10 MW/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 25 MW/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 30 MW/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 40 MW/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the six comprehensive program of sequence of voltage levels of Urban Distribution Network are respectively evaluated, The results proves that the model is effective and reasonable.

articleTitle: Study on the proportional allocation of electric vehicles with conventional and fast charge methods when in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper studies the hierarchical classification of electric vehicles (EV) by analyzing the differences of charging behaviors of different types of EVs. According to the different proportions of conventionally-charged EVs and fast-charged EVs, four indexes (the increment of peak load, the duration of peak load, the maximum smoothing index of load curve and the average smoothing index) are proposed to evaluate the impact on the distribution network. Then a method is established to configure the proportion of EV in different charging methods. Finally, based on the field data of a distribution network and the IEEE-34 node example, the optimal proportion of EV in different charging methods are made combined with the Monte Carlo simulation of charging load. Results show that suitable ratio of EV with different charging methods can make the load curve smoother and the grid's difference between peak and valley loads decrease significantly.

articleTitle: A new fault location method based on the correlation of zero mode current
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A new earth fault location method for non-effective earthed neutral network using transient signals measured at the bus terminal is presented. Based on the mode network of the single phase to ground fault, the s-domain equation of the faulty feeder is derived and the discrete difference equation is obtained by z-transform. Then fault distance is evaluated form transient data using the least square estimation. The adoption of Γ-mode equivalent circuit reduces the number of the parameters to be estimated and simplifies the distance estimation algorithm. The algorithm is effective on intermittence faults as it makes use of transient signals and, consequently, a shorter than half cycle data window. EMTP software was used for simulating the typical distribution system and MATLAB was used for data process. The simulation and calculation results proved the accuracy and reliability of the correlation coefficient method and entropy method. The fault location scheme proposed in this paper is valuable in practical application.

articleTitle: The wide-area measurement technology application in micro grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Micro grid has almost all the characteristics of large power grid.micro grid not only can operation with large power grid, but also can run independently ( referred to as the isolated operation mode ). As the diversity of generation element and load in the micro grid, large fluctuation characteristics of distributed generation, frequent disturbance of load, The flow characteristics, failure mechanism and the coordinated control issue of micro grid are more complex.so the measurement, protection, control technology of micro grid has bigger different from the traditional technology, should be conducted in special research. The wide-area measurement technology based on the IEEE1588 time synchronization can solve the problem better,The IEEE1588 can make use of the existing communication network, avoid the GPS timing recurrent missing steps. Based on the typical micro grid structure and micro grid automation control system architecture, provide the new automation control system framework of micro grid based on wide area measurement system, The idea and implementation scheme of micro power flow calculation, fault isolation and coordinated control based on the IEEE1588 is presented.

articleTitle: Study of modeling and scheduling control of distributed generation on distribution automation system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: An important feature of smart distribution different from traditional distribution network is to support a large number of distributed generation (DG) access. Modeling and scheduling control problems of DG need to be resolved on distribution automation system in the smart grid. In this paper, effect of DG on distribution network is analyzed first, and DG access requirements for distribution automation system are put forward. Considering the DG characteristics and scheduling control requirements for distribution automation system, DG modeling method and scheduling control function design are proposed on distribution automation system according to IEC 61968 modeling principles. Correctness of modeling method and feasibility of control principle are verified through using them in pilot project on OPEN-3200 distribution automation management system.

articleTitle: Application of 20kV high-voltage active power filter (APF)
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper analyzes the parameters of power-supply network and the harmonic characteristics of loads by researching the structures and operation ways of traction power-supply system of the train. It also analyzes and compares the current methods in removing current harmonics. Eventually, it comes up with the way using chain high-voltage APF to eliminate the harmonics. This paper describes the main circuit design and control strategy, among which the key technologies are chain APF harmonic detection algorithm, phase-splitting instantaneous current control and balanced DC voltage control. It builds up a simulation model based on actual parameters, and the simulation results show the compensation waveforms and effects which proves the project is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Current situation analysis and development strategies for distribution automation of guangdong grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The technology of distribution automation is vital for the future of smart distribution. As for the appropriate development and implementation of distribution automation, not only it should adapt to the distribution network characteristics, but also depends on the relative technologies of smart gird, such as smart terminal units, advanced communication and energy management. In this paper, based on the actual situation of distribution automation in Guangdong grid, an advanced strategy of distribution automation development is proposed targeting nowadays unbalanced regional development and different development levels. The strategy mainly divides the distribution automation into 4 parts including master station, automation terminal, feeder automation and communication network, and standardize for each part respectively. Through the permutation and combination, the appropriate development pattern for delaminating and districting operation could be retrieved, theoretically provides proofs for the reasonable development planning in the future distribution automation.

articleTitle: Smart traveling wave fault location system based on electronic transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The existing electronic transformer sampling frequency to meet the functional requirements of the measurement, protection, its sampling frequency is lower than 12.8K. Traveling wave fault location device required signal bandwidth of the M-Class. The required signal bandwidth should reach 500K even with the Line traps affect, which affected its promotion and application of digital substation. The authors proposed shunt sampling method to collect data in electronic transformer acquisition side and in part of the merging unit deal with common signal and traveling wave signal program. The program is both to meet the needs of the general device of the general signal, but also to meet the needs of the traveling wave fault location device on the traveling wave signal of the transient high-speed sampling. Smart traveling wave fault location device directly receive the IEC61850 standard format of digital signal processing fault location Algorithm to reduce the analog-digital conversion and processing sectors, ranging efficiency.

articleTitle: Power system short-term load combined forecasting approach based on sectional simulation forecasting method
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Power system short term load forecasting is very sensitive to the disturbance factors in the day load, which could not obtain the desired optimal results. In order to solve such problems, this paper proposes sectional simulation forecasting method. This paper takes a certain area as an example and demonstrates sectional simulation forecasting method by analyzing the characteristics from daily load of this area, and compare sectional simulation forecasting method with conventional method for short term load forecasting effect. It's easy to see, sectional simulation forecasting method, by contrast, is obviously superior to the conventional method of short-term load forecasting, and meets the power system load forecasting personnel's demands much better.

articleTitle: HK electric's experience of VLF diagnostic testing on distribution cables
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The 11kV distribution cables in HK Electric system are installed underground by direct burial method. PILC (Paper Insulated Lead Covered) cables were commonly installed prior to 1976, before the adoption of XLPE (Cross Linked Polyethylene) cables.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive tripping for single phase earth fault in neutral point non-effectively grounded system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Running with single-phase earth fault improves reliability of power supply in neutral point non-effectively grounded system, but arc-grounding and intermittent fault caused over-voltage is most likely to damage insulating security. In view of developing line-selection techniques, the increasingly success ratio of that has met the requirement on site, a new method is proposed for adaptive earth fault protection in neutral non-effectively grounded system, to be specific, the reliability of online monitoring fault line selection, the condition of over-voltage and insulation of line, severity of fault, line types and power supply reliability demand to the loads, adaptive fault line-selecting whether or when to trip, all above factors are taken comprehensively into consideration. The adaptive protection technology has been applied with well effect in enterprise grid of Shandong province of China.

articleTitle: The key technology research on transient stability control of micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper made a further research on the key technology of micro-grid transient stability control, and putted forward the distributed generations union scheduling Algorithm, that take the storage inverter control model as the core, Based on ultra-short-term forecasting of distributed generations output by means of BP neural network. It guaranteed micro-grid bus voltage to achieve “zero intermittent” during micro-grid transfered from grid-connected to island mode when city grid appearance fault. It ensures micro-grid running stably and maintained transient stability during disturbances in the island mode. It ensures the safe, steady and optimal economy operation of micro-grid.

articleTitle: Low-voltage ride through practice of double-fed wind turbine system
publicationTitle: 2012 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With unit capacity of wind turbine enlarging and total capacity of wind power expanding, the mutual influence between wind power and grid become more apparent. Especially when grid voltage drops, wind farm overall cutting out grid will lead to electric power system tidal current changing greatly, and even cause a large area blackout accident. So it is imperative to reconstruct current wind power to obtain low-voltage ride through (LVRT) ability. This article studied the influence of grid voltage dip on double-fed wind turbine of someone wind farm and put out LVRT reconstruction scheme. The retrofit schemes mainly contain adding crowbar behind dc side of frequency converter, modifying frequency converter's control power supply circuit, and replacing control program as well as parameters of the master control and frequency converter control etc. LVRT test result showed that, when three-phase balanced or unbalanced voltages dropped in grid, by keeping grid-connected state, the reconstructed turbines can help grid achieve LVRT. Wind farm LVRT reconstruction is important for distributed power integrating into grid in large scale.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of electric vehicle charging and discharging in microgrid
